jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Please note: this is a temporary assignment (through June 2027).**

The Senior Program Coordinator is responsible for providing individualized services to underrepresented, low-income, first-generation college students, and others at higher risk of experiencing academic difficulty to support their academic success. Responsibilities include assessing students’ academic needs, developing individualized study plans, identifying and addressing academic and non-academic barriers to success, and providing counseling and advising on factors affecting student retention and academic progress. The role may also involve specialized support for particular underrepresented groups, academic skills such as research and graduate school preparation, and success within specific academic programs.

  

**Required**

* Knowledge of academic advising, counseling, student development, and strategies that support student achievement.
* Knowledge of issues affecting students from diverse, underserved, disadvantaged, low-income, and first-generation backgrounds in higher education.
* Experience analyzing complex situations, identifying solutions, and supporting programs designed to meet diverse student needs.
* Experience reviewing and evaluating applications, academic records, transcripts, and other materials using established program criteria. Knowledge of research methodologies and research design.
* Experience researching, compiling, organizing, and analyzing data and preparing reports.
* Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment and work effectively with students, faculty, staff, and administrators.
* Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience or training.

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of conflict management and intervention strategies.
* Knowledge of applicable confidentiality, access, safety, and ethical requirements related to student services.

jobs.company: Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco Inc.
jobs.title: Gender Affirming Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Femmes Against Violence Program**  
**Program Coordinator**

***Full-time, Union Position***

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Description:** Femmes Against Violence (FAV) is an 18-week, cohort-based program that promotes healing, agency, leadership, and self-determination among youth ages 14–21, including femme-identified and gender-expansive youth of color. Offered twice annually, FAV engages youth three days per week through culturally affirming, gender-responsive, youth-centered programming.

The program integrates intersectional, liberatory frameworks grounded in Black feminist theory, Indigenous teachings, ancestral knowledge, collective care, and community accountability through interactive workshops, experiential activities, community outings, guest speakers, and youth-led action projects. Programming explores identity, culture, relationships, gender-based violence prevention, systems of power and oppression, and pathways toward personal and collective well-being. Youth develop critical consciousness, leadership, advocacy, communication, and self-determination skills while engaging in opportunities to apply their learning through creative and experiential activities.

FAV also provides a wraparound support model that connects youth to mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources. FAV creates a supportive space where youth can build belonging, strengthen their voices and leadership capacity, develop healthy coping and relationship skills, and envision and pursue futures grounded in care, justice, and self-determination.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee delivery of the FAV program in accordance with the approved work plan and scope of services, including outreach and recruitment, orientation and enrollment, life skills, peer education, leadership development, culturally and gender-affirming activities and events, youth-led projects, and related services.
* Develop, implement, and adapt program curriculum, workshops, training materials, and experiential activities that support FAV program goals and youth outcomes.
* Facilitate culturally and gender-affirming trainings, workshops, group activities, presentations, and community outings for FAV participants.
* Support youth in developing and implementing creative projects, presentations, educational materials, and other activities that promote awareness, leadership, advocacy, and positive community engagement.
* Work collaboratively with other Horizons programs to ensure a cohesive program model and coordinated services for participating youth.
* Advocate for FAV participants and support access to appropriate services, resources, and opportunities.
* Communicate regularly with participants regarding program participation, needs, progress, and available resources.
* Cultivate and maintain working relationships with schools, community-based organizations, government agencies, SFUSD Wellness Centers, Community Health Outreach Workers, and other appropriate partners to recruit and enroll youth and maintain a strong referral network.
* Network and participate in community committees, meetings, and collaborative efforts that promote FAV, strengthen partnerships, and expand resources and opportunities for participants.
* Coordinate with participants and staff to implement evaluation and feedback tools that measure program effectiveness, participant satisfaction, and progress toward program outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and timely program records, participant documentation, data, reports, and budgets, including required entries into the agency's CMS and GMS system.
* Facilitate connections to wraparound and support services, including mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources.
* Participate in weekly team meetings, individual supervision, and other internal meetings that support effective program delivery and professional development.
* Complete required agency and funder trainings and maintain knowledge of applicable program standards, policies, and funding requirements.
* Participate in at least one agency-wide committee, project, or working group annually.
* Attend agency and funder meetings, quarterly All Grantee meetings, and other meetings that support programmatic integration within the agency and broader community.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by the Program Director.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree in psychology, women’s or ethnic studies and/or a closely related field, and/or comparable experience to meet this requirement (2+ years).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience working with self-identified young women of color who have been system-impacted.
* Direct knowledge regarding youth development and empowerment principles, intervention strategies, best practices in serving system-impacted youth, harm reduction, etc.
* Experience coordinating after-school, leadership or other youth programming.
* Extensive knowledge of gender-based violence intervention strategies, sexual assault, domestic violence a must.

jobs.title: Community Program Coordinator (Five88 & The Coronet)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self-reliance and personal growth.  
  
Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project-access.org/success-stories/

**The opportunity**

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

  

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth & Families, Health & Wellness, and Community Building.
* Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
* Coordinate and oversee an after-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Coordinate and oversee diversified programs, activities and special events for seniors, including bingo, arts and crafts, monthly birthday parties, and lite exercise programs, as space permits.
* Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
* Develop & maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
* Plan & facilitate community-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information & referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
* Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
* Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door-to-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high-traffic locations.
* Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
* Collect & submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
* Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.

**What you'll bring**

* Bilingual English/Cantonese or English/Mandarin preferred
* Four years of experience in multi-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.

  + serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.

* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description:

* Act as a strategic thought partner and advisor for business leaders on organizational design and effectiveness, workforce planning, talent practices, compensation, employee relations, learning and development.
* Lead organizational transformations; help design organizations in line with business strategy to drive change and transition management.
* Facilitate and drive all people experience programs for the department - onboarding, performance management, high-potential development program nominations, compensation planning, engagement survey action planning, and recognition programs.

* Knowledge of compensation strategies and packages that include equity.

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

jobs.title: Receivership Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Griswold Receivers is seeking a full-time California Receivership Project Coordinator to support the management and oversight of 40–45 active receivership projects. This is a hybrid role that will include traveling to properties across Northern California and Nevada as needed.

In the field, you’ll conduct site inspections, coordinate with city inspectors and contractors to plan and schedule work, manage property needs such as utility setup, fencing, and security, help relocate occupants and tenants, and track overall project progress. The Project Coordinator will report to the Director, Northern California Property Management and work closely with the Operations Team to carry out day-to-day tasks for each project.

The Receivership Project Coordinator will help coordinate receivership projects from start to finish, keeping them on time, on budget, and done well. We’re looking for a proactive team player who likes working with others and takes initiative to keep projects moving. Partnering closely with the Director of Northern California Property Management, this role monitors properties, resolves issues quickly, and plays a key part in carrying out court-appointed receivership responsibilities.

 **Compensation:**

$75,000 - $85,000 yearly

 **Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple receivership projects from start to finish.
* Travel to properties throughout Northern California and Nevada to conduct inspections, monitor progress, and address issues.
* Work with city inspectors, contractors, and vendors to schedule and plan required work.
* Assist with the setup and management of property services, including utilities, fencing, and security.
* Support the relocation of occupants and tenants as needed, including identifying options and coordinating logistics.
* Monitor project timelines to keep projects on track.
* Maintain accurate records of property conditions and work performed, including photos and inspection notes.
* Prepare regular status updates and reports for the Director and Operations Team.
* Respond to urgent property issues such as damage, vandalism, or security concerns.
* Act as a point of contact for tenants and neighbors, handling concerns professionally and maintaining positive relationships.
* Work with internal teams and outside stakeholders to keep projects running efficiently.

 **Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years of property management and/or construction management experience.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-compliance environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic project management tools.

 **About Company**

Griswold Receivers and its professionals serve exclusively as Court-appointed neutrals in a variety of legal scenarios, including health & safety receiverships, tenant habitability receiverships, post-judgment receiverships, business dispute receiverships, rents/profits receiverships, and partition actions. These matters often lead to a variety of types of rehabilitation and construction projects.

We embrace a team-centric environment and approach to support one another in our respective roles, while also remaining flexible and adaptable to take on different roles as the project may require. Our team possesses a high level of integrity and keeps a level head during high-pressure or potentially volatile situations without losing sight of the end goal.

**COMPENSATION & COMPANY BENEFITS INCLUDE:**

Salary is dependent on experience & skillset. Benefits include an incentive plan, 401(k) (after waiting period), paid holidays, wellness reimbursement program, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Case Manager, THP (Bilingual)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Hamilton Families, our mission is to end family homelessness in the San Francisco Bay Area. Since 1985, we have been meeting the most urgent needs of unhoused families in our community. Our programs specialize in preventing family homelessness when possible, providing shelter and transitional housing to families in times of need, supporting the wellbeing and academic achievement of children who experience homelessness, and quickly returning families to safe and stable housing throughout the Greater Bay Area. At Hamilton Families, we believe the San Francisco Bay Area is at its best when people from all backgrounds can start a life here, raise a family here, and thrive here. We envision a Bay Area where housing is accessible and affordable, where homelessness is rare, brief, and nonrecurring, and where all people and families have a safe and stable place to live. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued and contribute to our collective success. Our commitment to inclusivity ensures every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to thrive.

**What You’ll Do**

We’re excited to be adding a **Case Manager** toour team! This is an engaging and rewarding opportunity that plays an integral role within the organization. We are looking for someone who is passionate about working with our participants and contributing to the fight against homelessness. The **Case Manager** will report directly to the Family Services Manager and be part of the Shelter Program team. This position provides case management to families in the shelter program using various service models. This involves documenting services in real-time, maintaining electronic case records, and collecting monthly compliance reports.

**What Your Day Looks Like**

* Offer personalized case management to participants, guiding them through intake, assessments, and tailored service plans that meet their unique needs
* Connect individuals with vital community resources, advocating for housing, employment, and support in areas like mental and physical health, domestic violence recovery, and family reunification
* Design and facilitate dynamic workshops that empower participants with essential life skills and strategies for crisis intervention
* Welcome families during intake and orientation, collaborating to create actionable plans that address housing, recovery, and children’s needs
* Build strong networks with community services to ensure participants receive the support they deserve
* Work closely with case managers, supervisors, and community partners to provide seamless and effective support for families
* Uphold program policies while keeping clear and accurate records of participant progress and experiences
* Prepare and submit insightful reports that highlight the impact of services and track our program's success
* Actively participate in team meetings, training sessions, and community events to strengthen our mission
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and organizational policies, and attend hearings as needed
* Encourage participant involvement in decision-making and program activities, fostering a sense of ownership
* Take on additional responsibilities as requested to support our mission

**What Makes You Successful in This Role**

* Ability to work and collaborate with a diverse group of people on projects and making decisions for the benefit of our participants
* Familiarity with case management databases or customer service platforms
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working independently to meet goals
* Demonstrated ability to exercise appropriate judgement and uphold policies and procedures
* Skilled in documentation, reporting, and maintaining confidentiality

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience in social work, psychology, human services setting or related field
* A background in working with nonprofit organizations, social services organizations, or community-based programs
* Familiarity with Bay Area resources for low-income families
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, and other software
* Ability to travel locally and long distance to meet with vendors and participants

**Why Choose Us**

* Our commitment to welcome all individuals creates a richness of viewpoints and keen ability to challenge established thinking
* Enjoy excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Employer matched 403(b) retirement plan
* Wellness and commuter benefit programs
* Paid time off and holidays

**Our Values**

* Resourceful
* Helpful/ “Yes, And”
* Growth Mindset
* Data Informed
* EDI: Equitable, Diverse, and Inclusive

**Salary Range:** $28.00/ hour

**Bilingual Premium (Spanish):** $1.50 extra per hour

**Position Type:** Full-time, Non-Exempt

**Union Representation:** Yes

**Schedule:** 40 hours with evenings and/or one weekend day required (10:00am to 6:30pm or 10:30am to 7:00pm)

**Location:** 260 Golden Gate Ave, San Francisco, CA 94102

***Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.***

**ABOUT US**  
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. The Operations Manager partners with the General Manager to run a clean, safe, and welcoming club and deliver an exceptional member experience. This role leads the club's front-line operations team, including Club Attendants, Sales & Service Overnights, Sales & Service Associates, and Kids' Club Attendants (at clubs with a Kids' Club), and is accountable for front desk and member service, Kids' Club (where applicable), club cleanliness, club retail, and day-to-day club administration. jobs.title: Sustainability Program Manager
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About This Role:**

* As a Sustainability Program Manager, you will be an important member of Crusoe's sustainability team, transforming sustainability commitments into day-to-day operational reality. You will own the processes, training, and tracking that make our sustainability KPIs achievable and enforceable across a rapidly expanding portfolio of AI data centers and energy assets. You’ll work directly with cross-functional teams to translate targets into requirements, workflows, and accountability at the site and project level. This role suits someone with technical fluency in how manufacturing facilities and data centers are built and run, who is energized by designing scalable processes, driving adoption, and closing the gap between commitment and performance.

**What You’ll Be Working On:**

* Lead operational sustainability initiatives related to water, waste, and carbon, from scoping through delivery, building project plans, aligning stakeholders, tracking milestones, and surfacing risks early.
* Support sustainability implementation throughout the lifecycle of data center projects by helping to define, monitor, and improve data center construction and operational efficiency metrics, including embodied carbon, waste diversion, PUE, and WUE. Partner with internal teams and external partners to identify performance gaps and drive improvements.
* Design and implement the processes, SOPs, and checklists that embed sustainability requirements into manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and site operations, and train site teams, contractors, and partners to apply them consistently.
* Support green building certification strategies (e.g., LEED, Green Globes) across new builds, coordinating documentation, consultants, and design team inputs.
* Build and maintain dashboards, trackers, and automated workflows that give teams timely visibility into operational performance, using AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort.
* Manage renewable energy tracking and energy performance data, working with Energy, Finance, and Operations teams to monitor portfolio status and surface risks and opportunities.
* Provide as-needed support across the broader sustainability team, flexing into emerging priorities, ad-hoc data requests, and new initiatives as the business evolves.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, environmental science, sustainability, data analytics, or a related field. Candidates from other backgrounds with demonstrated technical depth are encouraged to apply.
* **Experience:** 4-7 years of professional experience in sustainability operations, construction or energy management, supply chain or supplier management, or environmental consulting, ideally within the data center, cloud infrastructure, energy, or technology sectors. This should include hands-on management of operational programs, performance metrics, or compliance and enforcement processes.
* **Data Center & Energy Knowledge:** Strong understanding of data center construction and operations, including metrics (PUE, WUE, CUE) and power, cooling, and energy systems. Familiarity with renewable energy instruments and energy markets.
* **Program Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, and influence stakeholders.
* **Process Design:** Proven ability to design, document, and roll out scalable processes, SOPs, and controls across many stakeholders and sites, and to drive adoption and adherence.
* **Supply Chain & Vendor Engagement**: Experience engaging suppliers, contractors, or vendors to set requirements, build capability, and hold them accountable to performance expectations, including through contract terms, scorecards, and corrective action.
* **Technical & Analytical Skills:** Advanced proficiency in Excel and strong data skills, such as SQL, Python, or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker). Experience building trackers, dashboards, and data quality controls.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex sustainability data into clear narratives for diverse stakeholders.
* **Adaptability & Ownership**: Self-starter who exercises sound judgment under ambiguity, proactively surfaces risks and opportunities, and takes full ownership of outcomes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity with green building certifications (LEED AP, Green Globes) or embodied carbon in construction, including whole building LCA tools (e.g., EC3, One Click LCA, Tally).
* Experience running supplier engagement or responsible sourcing programs, such as supplier scorecards, audits, or sustainability requirements in procurement.
* Comfort using AI tool

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Program Manager II
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe is growing rapidly, and the way we recruit has to keep up. Many of the practices that carried us this far, such as workflows patched together with one-off configurations, tooling choices made vendor by vendor, and process knowledge that lives with a few individuals, will not hold as hiring volume rises and we open in new countries.

We are hiring a senior owner to build what comes next.

You will be responsible for the product side of Talent Acquisition: advising on the road map for our recruiting tech stack (Ashby, sourcing tools, Metaview), the design of hiring workflows from requisition intake to onboarding handoff, and the programs that make our processes work globally. Right now, improvements tend to happen when someone feels enough pain to raise them. In this role, you make improvement a steady, planned part of how TA works.

The right person is a program manager who designs durable systems rather than one-time fixes, is comfortable with workflow automation and AI-enabled tools, and can keep recruiters, hiring managers, and vendors on track without having them report to you.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* *Recruiting technology and vendor strategy*

  + Advise TA leadership on the roadmap for the recruiting tech stack. Identify where automation, AI, integrations, and self-service can reduce manual work across Ashby, our sourcing tools, and Metaview.
  + Partner with vendors and internal partners on how AI and agentic tools can make recruiters more effective, and confirm that each technology choice is sustainable to maintain.
  + Create a lightweight framework for evaluating and approving new tools, since none exists today.
* *Workflow analysis and process redesign*

  + Map the full candidate and hiring lifecycle, from requisition intake through offer and onboarding handoff, and surface friction and duplicated effort proactively.
  + Redesign processes with methods such as Lean, Six Sigma, and the 5 Whys, weighing system configuration, user experience, and policy changes against the outcome you want.
  + Maintain current process documentation and workflow maps so that Recruiting, People Technology, and Legal can self-serve instead of submitting requests.
* *Business cases, metrics, and prioritization*

  + Write business cases that put numbers on operational impact, experience gains, and ROI, then use them to rank initiatives by impact, scalability, and strategic fit.
  + Work with Recruiting leadership and Analytics to define and report on core recruiting metrics, and investigate the underlying cause when a target is missed.
  + Support preparation of the regular metrics reviews and executive summaries TA leadership shares with the business.
  + Track adoption and realized ROI against each business case after launch.
* *Global expansion enablement*

  + Build recruiting processes and tooling that scale and meet local requirements as we enter new regions, working closely with Legal, Compliance, and regional partners.
  + Build local hiring regulations, data privacy, and AI compliance into designs from the start rather than adding them later.
  + Develop a reusable launch playbook for hiring at each new site.
* *Program and portfolio management*

  + Lead transformation and technology initiatives from start to finish: scoping, requirements, project plans, user acceptance testing, launch readiness, and post-launch review.
  + Run pilots and phased rollouts with success criteria agreed in advance, and use the results to expand, refine, or retire the initiative.
  + Balance the full portfolio of work against competing priorities, capacity, and timelines.
* *Change management and adoption*

  + Manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholders across Recruiting, People Technology, Legal, Compliance, and the business, and clear blockers early.
  + Plan the communications, training, and feedback loops for every rollout. A launch only counts once people are using the new way of working.
* *Systems and automation*

  + Treat repeated manual follow-up as a signal that something needs to be automated, and replace it with a form, workflow, dashboard, or scheduled alert.
  + Keep the configuration, documentation, and structure of the tools and files these programs depend on in good order, and move work into proper systems wherever they exist.
  + Produce a playbook that any recruiter, coordinator, or program manager can follow without your involvement.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8+ years in recruiting operations, including TA program management, or product management, with experience in a fast-growing company and a history of taking on broader scope and influence.
* A record of leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs from business case through launch, including UAT, communications

jobs.title: Program Manager, Data Transformation
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

As Program Manager, Data Transformation, you will run the day-to-day program engine that turns Oura's business data into governed, trusted, decision-ready metrics. You will work inside the Data Transformation program, alongside the Staff Program Manager, and own the delivery rhythm for your assigned data domains: intake, prioritization, tracking, ownership, certification, and reporting. Early focus areas include Hardware and Supply Chain, where the need for structure is greatest.A core part of the job is metric certification and intake discipline. You will enforce the three-path model for every request and metric: Directional (fit for use, fast), Governed (executive, board, investor, or external numbers, with a certification path), and Not ours (operational or application work rerouted to the owning business team). You will also drive the work itself, including sprints where they help, so certification and delivery commitments actually land.Hardware and supply chain data, for example, spans manufacturing, quality, logistics, sourcing, planning, and new product introduction. This role connects those teams to Data Engineering and Analytics so that the numbers executives, finance, and auditors rely on (for example warranty rate, click-to-delivery, and yield) have one definition, one owner, and a clear path from directional to governed to certified.This role is ideal for a program manager who is comfortable in ambiguity, can read a data pipeline diagram as easily as a project plan, and likes bringing structure to fast-moving, cross-functional work.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Take business metrics from informally tracked to fully certified, each with a locked definition, a single accountable owner, and documented lineage and controls
* Make sure every key metric in your domains has a clear owner and approver, and keep that ownership current as the business changes
* Triage incoming data requests by their intended use and level of rigor, and route work that belongs to other teams to the right place
* Run a structured intake process with clear priorities, business justification, and reliable response times
* Drive cross-functional programs to completion across Data Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Hardware, and IT, using agile practices where they help
* Keep program plans accurate and visible, with named leads, dates, and status that stakeholders can trust
* Track data issues and metric regressions through to resolution, and support documentation for internal and external audit
* Communicate progress and data health clearly to senior leaders, and drive adoption of standardized metric definitions

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

### **What you'll bring**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in program management, technical program management, or business operations, including time supporting data, analytics, or operations teams
* Experience running cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and competing priorities, without formal authority
* Experience with metric governance or controls work: definitions, ownership, documentation, and formal sign-off
* Comfortable working in Databricks or a similar lakehouse: can navigate the catalog, read a SQL query or model to understand how a metric is computed, and spot-check numbers against source tables
* Working understanding of data pipelines and transformation layers (dbt or equivalent): can follow lineage from source system to reported number and explain where a metric is computed
* Experience with data quality controls: defining validation tests, reading test results, and tracing failures to root cause
* Comfort holding a process line with senior stakeholders, including redirecting requests, while keeping relationships intact
* Hands-on experience with work tracking tools such as Jira, and with running sprints or lightweight agile cadences
* Clear written and verbal communication, including status reporting for senior audiences
  

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience with hardware, manufacturing, quality, logistics, sourcing, or supply planning
* Background in consumer hardware, wearables, medical devices, or another regulated hardware business
* Exposure to financial reporting, SOX-style controls, audit preparation, or IPO readiness
* Experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO company
* Experience working with distributed teams across US and European time zones
* Comfort using modern AI tooling to speed up analysis, documentation, and reporting

### **Benefits**

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive salary
* Lunch benefit
* Wellness benefit
* Flexible working hours
* Collaborative, smart teammates
* An Ōura ring of your own

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Veeco**  
You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

  

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers.

  

**OVERVIEW**
============

  

Veeco is transferring existing Advanced Packaging Lithography and Laser Annealing products to contract manufacturing partners in Asia for reliable volume production. This position will report to Vice President, Supply Chain in a full-time role requiring significant international engagement during the first 6–12 months to support new contract manufacturing partnerships in Asia. 25%–50% global travel

As Senior Program Manager, Contract Manufacturing Operations, you will lead this high-complexity transfer from integrated planning through manufacturing readiness, aligning suppliers and Veeco teams on schedule, quality, cost, and production objectives. Your work will strengthen the scale and execution behind technologies Veeco uses in advanced semiconductor fabrication and packaging. During this 6–12 month rotational assignment, you will establish the operating rhythm, controls, and supplier capability required for a successful ramp; after the assignment, you are expected to move into a broader Operations role supporting Manufacturing or Supply Chain, based on business needs.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
====================

* Own the end-to-end transfer of existing Advanced Packaging Lithography and Laser Annealing products to contract manufacturers in Asia, delivering production readiness against agreed schedule, quality, cost, and capacity objectives.
* Build and maintain the integrated program plan, critical path, decision log, risk register, and mitigation actions that keep supplier and Veeco workstreams aligned.
* Lead cross-functional execution across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and supplier teams, resolving system-level issues and clarifying ownership.
* Direct supplier training, early learning builds, and production-readiness reviews at supplier and Veeco locations worldwide, converting build results into closure plans and repeatable processes.
* Provide executive-level reporting on schedule, technical status, cost, resource needs, and risks, with clear decisions and recovery actions.
* Deliver operational-excellence and cost-reduction initiatives that improve manufacturability, throughput, quality, and total cost while protecting product performance.
* Establish durable governance, metrics, and escalation paths that enable contract manufacturing partners to sustain volume production after transfer completion.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 8 years of related experience leading engineering, manufacturing, or product-transfer programs for semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, or similarly complex capital equipment.
* Experience leading multiple concurrent programs that involve cross-functional teams, external suppliers, and executive stakeholders.
* Experience managing new product introduction or product-transfer work through manufacturing readiness and production ramp.
* Ability to travel globally 25%–50% during the 6–12 month rotational assignment.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**
====================================

* Working knowledge of Advanced Packaging Lithography and/or Laser Annealing equipment, or the ability to apply experience from comparable electro-mechanical and automated capital equipment.
* Expertise in integrated scheduling, critical-path management, risk management, budget control, resource planning, and executive reporting.
* Skilled at diagnosing system-level manufacturing issues and aligning engineering, operations, quality, and supplier teams on practical corrective actions.
* Knowledge of new product introduction, new product development, product lifecycle management, configuration control, and manufacturing-readiness practices.
* Ability to distill complex technical, schedule, and cost information into clear decisions and concise updates for executives and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Power BI, Smartsheet, enterprise resource planning and material requirements planning systems, and product lifecycle management tools; experience with SAP is preferred.
* Experience reading engineering drawings and working with computer-aided design tools such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD is preferred.

**Salary and Benefits**  
The expected salary range for this position is $156,351.00 - 198,044.00, plus a bonus opportunity. We will consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors when determining your pay.

  

Other benefits include:

* Life and Accident Insurance

jobs.description:
**Implementation Manager - San Francisco**

As a key member of the Product function, the Implementation Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional teams to guide embedded clients (NeoBanks, Marketplaces, Payroll companies) through implementations. This role combines project management excellence, API implementation coordination, and relationship management to ensure our most complex partnerships achieve exceptional outcomes while building repeatable processes for future growth.

In this role, you'll work alongside Product Managers, Partnership Managers, and dedicated specialists from Operations and Compliance to deliver world-class implementation experiences.

**About us**

Sokin is a next-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency.  
Our mission is simple: we’re simplifying global business - so businesses thrive wherever they choose to grow. We deliver services across:

* Global payments and receivables
* Foreign Exchange (FX)
* Treasury management
* Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America, backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide.

Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we’re building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Orchestration**

Cross-functional Team Coordination: Coordinate a bespoke Implementation team made of individuals from Sokin Sales, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations teams, based globally, throughout the implementation lifecycle, ensuring clients’ onboarding and operating experience is fast and easy

**Implementation Planning:** Create and maintain implementation plans with clear deliverables, timelines, owners, and dependencies for both Sokin and client teams, driving accountability and momentum

**Stakeholder Alignment**: Facilitate appropriate meetings and communication channels to ensure all teams remain aligned on priorities, timelines, and evolving client expectations

**Resource Coordination:** Work with department leads to align cross-team resources across multiple concurrent implementations, managing competing priorities and ensuring optimal team usage and efficient implementation pipelines.

**Client impact analysis:** Gather data around expected client impact (volume projections, expected response times etc) and share with product and engineering as contributions to the product prioritisation and planning process

**Risk Management**

**Proactive Risk Identification:** Continuously assess and document implementation risks including technical, commercial, regulatory, and operational threats to successful delivery

**Escalation Management:** Establish clear escalation paths and proactively escalate blockers to appropriate stakeholders before they impact timelines, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining implementation momentum

**Issue Resolution Leadership:** Lead cross-functional issue resolution efforts, bringing together the right expertise and decision-makers to unblock progress and prevent recurring problems

**Implementation Reviews & Handoff**

**Success Criteria Validation:** Collaborate with client teams to define clear, measurable acceptance criteria for the implementation and ensure all requirements are met before go-live

**Go-Live Coordination:** Orchestrate go-live activities across all teams, providing immediate post-launch support and monitoring to ensure smooth transition to production for the client

**Handoff Execution:** Execute structured handoffs to ongoing support teams with documentation, knowledge transfer sessions, and transition planning

**Post-Implementation Review:** Conduct thorough lessons learned sessions with internal teams to capture improvement opportunities and celebrate successes

**Process Improvement**

**Journey Process Documentation:** Create, maintain, and continuously improve detailed process documentation for embedded client implementation journeys

**Process Optimization:** Analyze implementation data, client feedback, and team insights to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process enhancement

**Cross-team Feedback Integration:** Collect, synthesize, and act upon feedback from all internal teams based on implementation experiences and client interactions

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years of implementation or project management experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or fintech environments
* Proven track record managing complex enterprise implementations involving APIs, integrations, or embedded solutions from initiation through completion
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder relationships in matrix organizations with competing priorities
* Stakeholder management experience managing relationships with technical stakeholders, and C-level executives
* Background in payments, financial services, embedded finance, marketplace technologies, or API-driven products preferred

*Please note, candidates will need to have the right to work in the jurisdiction that they are looking to work in.*

*Sokin is an equal opportunities employer and committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. As a growing global startup with bases across multiple countries, we were established on and continue to promote an agile, flexible working culture. Please reach out to discuss any accommodations you may require during the recruitment process.*

CTI has been a leading audiovisual provider since we began in 1988, and from the beginning our mission has been simple: to provide a fantastic customer experience.

The position requires independent execution of advanced modeling tasks, close collaboration with structural engineers, and mentorship of junior designers to deliver high-quality, code-compliant structural documents.

* Assist in analysis, coordination, troubleshooting and resolving complex software issues, conducting advanced modeling tasks, and identifying process improvements for BIM/CAD workflows.
* Prepare 3D visualizations and coordination views for constructability reviews and client presentations.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* Associate’s degree or certification in CAD, BIM, Architecture, Engineering, or related field.
* 2 - 6 years of experience in CAD/BIM design within building and infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience producing structural construction documents and coordinating with engineering teams.

Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. Better Places.

  

**The Role**

Stratus® has recently partnered with E.A. Bonelli, and we're hiring a Design Technician for our Structural engineering group. This role is responsible for creating, managing, and coordinating complex structural design models and construction documentation for building and infrastructure projects. This role leads our structural BIM/CAD efforts, ensures alignment with engineering calculations and design intent, and supports multi-disciplinary coordination. The position requires independent execution of advanced modeling tasks, close collaboration with structural engineers, and mentorship of junior designers to deliver high-quality, code-compliant structural documents.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop detailed structural 2D and 3D CAD/BIM models (g.Framing plans, foundation plans, sections, details, connection layouts) aligned with engineering calculations and specifications.
* Lead multi-disciplinary coordination, ensuring structural systems integrate with architectural, MEP and civil models without clashes.
* Perform and oversee control reviews of structural drawings and models, verifying accuracy, constructability, and compliance with applicable building codes and project standards.
* Collaborate closely with structural engineers to translate design criteria, load paths, and calculations into accurate constructible documents.
* Mentor junior designers on structural drafting standards, detailing best practices, and BIM/CAD workflows.
* Generate and manage structural construction documents, including general notes, schedules (steel, rebar, concrete), and detailed sections.
* Support development of shop drawing reviews, RFIs and design revisions by incorporating engineering changes into BIM/CAD models and plan sets.
* Establish and maintain structural BIM standards, including model organization, naming conventions, and level of development (LOD).
* Assist in analysis, coordination, troubleshooting and resolving complex software issues, conducting advanced modeling tasks, and identifying process improvements for BIM/CAD workflows.
* Prepare 3D visualizations and coordination views for constructability reviews and client presentations.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* Associate’s degree or certification in CAD, BIM, Architecture, Engineering, or related field.
* 2 - 6 years of experience in CAD/BIM design within building and infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience producing structural construction documents and coordinating with engineering teams.

**Why you’ll love Stratus**

* Understanding of the strategic, operational, and financial components of a construction project
* Ability to make timely and effective decisions
* Experience managing projects successfully from start to finish
* Skilled at developing and negotiating relationships with owners and trade contractors

DBIA and LEED Accreditation a plus

Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.

  

**A Drug Free Workplace:** Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.

jobs.description:
The **County of San Mateo’s Technology Services Department** **(TSD)** seeks a **Radio Systems** **IS Project Manager I** to support Radio Services and assigned initiatives within the Network Service Division (NSD). This position combines project management with customer relationship management and administration of the agreements, vendor contracts, and licenses that support these services.

The primary responsibilities include managing assigned Radio Services and NSD projects; serving as a liaison to public safety partners, County departments, and other customers; coordinating Radio Services memoranda of understanding (MOUs) and lease agreements; administering assigned vendor contracts and licenses; translating Radio Services MOU deliverables into trackable customer billing routines; and maintaining project information in the department’s Planview project management suite.

-----------

Employee will be assigned to Facilities Management Service, Project Development Section, VA Healthcare System, Palo Alto, CA. The primary purpose of this position is to plan, coordinate, and execute all building and space activation, transition, and deactivation activities across the campus. The position also supports capital asset planning and manages space assignments and project management for capital construction projects to optimize utilization and align facilities with strategic goals.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

  

**Duties**
----------

\*\***\*THIS IS NOT A VIRTUAL POSITION, YOU MUST LIVE WITHIN OR BE WILLING TO RELOCATE WITHIN A COMMUTABLE DISTANCE OF THE DUTY LOCATION\*\*\***
  
  
This position involves a **multi-grade career ladder.** The major duties listed below represent the full performance level of GS-12. At the GS-11 grade level, you will perform assignments of a more limited scope and with less independence. You will progressively acquire the background necessary to perform at the full performance level of GS-12. Promotion is at the discretion of the supervisor and is contingent upon satisfactory performance, availability of higher-level work, and availability of funds.

* Provides oversight, direction, guidance, and technical expertise on assigned project component.

The position requires a strong analytical and technical understanding of capital asset inventory, capital construction budgetary cycles, requirements generation for capital projects, and capital construction proposal requests valued between $5M-$500M.

jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** Monday - Friday, 9am -5:30pm
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a family of programs, is located across 13 different counties in California. HealthRIGHT 360 provides an array of medical and behavioral health services to some of the most marginalized populations, ranging from primary care, mental health services, detox, substance use disorder treatment in both residential and outpatient settings, and transitional services for the criminal justice population.
  
Asian Drug and Alcohol Prevention Treatment (ADAPT) is an adult outpatient program that provides culturally competent substance use and mental health services in English and Chinese. The AARS Project ADAPT offers a strengths-based, trauma-informed, harm reduction approach. Services include individual, group and case management services as well as acupuncture and access to free cultural/recreational events. We also have free community lunches and encourage developing supportive relationships and community. Our goals are to provide a safe and respectful counseling space for people from all walks of life and to reduce the impact of substance use and mental health conditions that lead to healthy, meaningful lives.
  
The Substance Use Counselor II at Project ADAPT works with a interdisciplinary team to provide substance use treatment, assessing client needs and strengths in support of health and recovery. The SUD II Counselor provides individual, group counseling using evidence-based curricula in accordance with program specific requirements (Drug Medi-Cal) as well as case management to assist clients in navigating systems of care and connecting to community resources (e.g. vocational, primary care, housing).

* Provides clinical support and evidence-based interventions to support clients in meeting their treatment goals.
* Proactively links clients to both internal and external resources based on their treatment needs and follows up on their progress/status.

* Facilitates group counseling sessions, community meetings and teaches classes on various treatment related topics.
* Performs crisis intervention and communicates with treatment team as unforeseen situations arise.
* Plans and facilitates client celebrations and special events.
* Attends required trainings and meetings related to their position.

**Documentation Responsibilities:**  

* Collaborates with each caseload client and other available internal and external resources to develop/maintain treatment plans, transition plans, progress notes and appropriate updates in support of the health and recovery needs of the client.
* Properly documents all aspects of treatment including services and treatment planning in accordance with HIPPA and Drug Medi-Cal billing compliance requirements. This includes completing all consent forms, authorizations to release information, individual and group counseling sessions, discharge paperwork/process, and required assessments in a timely manner.
* Maintains accurate records by data entering documentation into various electronic systems for all caseload clients in accordance with guidelines established by HealthRIGHT 360 to satisfy internal and external evaluating requirements.

And, other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Overnight Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overnight Care Coordinator Position Description:**

The overnight care coordinator provides supervision and support to clients in the residential treatment facility during the overnight shift.

**Overnight Care Coordinator Primary Responsibilities:**

* Monitor the residential milieu overnight by conducting rounds in timeframes prescribed by agency policy and procedure
* Ensure the safety and security of clients and the facility
* Assist clients with their needs and refer them to their counselor for clinical support
* Maintain continuity among work teams by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities and ongoing client needs in chart and shift log notes
* Perform urinalysis testing as needed
* Educate and remind clients of the rules, policies and procedures of the facility.
* Establish appropriate boundaries amongst clients and staff, ensuring professional and courteous interactions and fostering opportunities to implement newly developed life skills
* Assist with medication monitoring, counting, and compliance as needed
* Set up, serve, and monitor client breakfast
* Wash linens and perform light household tasks
* Ensure cleanliness of office and client treatment areas
* Perform additional duties as assigned by the program director

**Overnight Care Coordinator Qualifications:**

* One-year practical experience in drug/alcohol or mental health field preferred (employment, internship or volunteer work); preferred RADT, working towards certification in drug and alcohol counseling
* Basic understanding of treatment and rehabilitation techniques
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively within a team as well as alone
* Ability to work effectively with people differing in value systems, ethnicity, cultural backgrounds, language capabilities and disabilities
* Exercise good judgment and respond calmly in emergency situations
* Ability to work effectively; independently and within a group, with limited supervision
* Must maintain the highest standards of professional ethics and behavior as described in the Pathway Society handbook.
* Must be able to physically respond to clients’ needs, climb stairs and walk through the facility throughout the shift
* Must pass a criminal records clearance as required the County of Santa Clara Department of Alcohol and Drugs regulations.
* Receive training and pass certification testing in the areas of HIPAA, 42 CFR and CPR/First Aid once county clearance is received.

**Overnight Care Coordinator Physical Requirements**

* Climbing; ascending or descending stairs, ramps, using feet and legs and/or hands and arms.
* Kneeling; bending legs at knee to come to a rest on knee or knees.
* Crouching; bending the body downward and forward by bending leg and spine.
* Reaching; extending hand (s) and arms above head in any direction.
* Hearing; perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction, ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.
* Lifting; able to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects up to 20 pounds.
* Visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures and viewing a computer terminal.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, activities and scheduled shift may change at any time, with or without notice.

jobs.description:
**This position is 100% in office!!!**

  

At **Muir Home Health** , we believe that home healthcare is more than just a service – it’s a commitment to enhancing the quality of life of every individual we serve. Nestled in the heart of the vibrant East Bay area of California, we are on a mission to revolutionize the way home health is perceived and delivered.

  

**Muir Home Health is growing and looking for an experienced and compassionate Scheduling/Intake Coordinator to join our team!** As a scheduling/intake coordinator with Muir Home Health, you will have the opportunity to advance your career while receiving strong compensation and excellent benefits.

  

**BENEFITS**

* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* 401(k) plan with generous company match
* Critical illness benefit
* Paid time off
Employee assistance program  

  

**Pay Range:** $24.00 - $34.00/hr

**Job Type:** Full Time

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

  

The Intake Coordinator/Scheduler is responsible for managing all aspects of the patient intake and staffing processes to support the operations of the Home Health Agency. This role serves as a central point of coordination, communicating directly with patients, families, referral sources, and internal staff to ensure seamless delivery of services.

Key responsibilities include overseeing patient intake, performing data entry, verifying insurance and obtaining authorizations, and facilitating daily intake stand-up meetings. The coordinator also manages clinician scheduling and workflow completion in Home Care Home Base, ensuring accurate alignment of patient needs with staff availability.

This position requires building and maintaining positive relationships with patients, families, clinical field staff, contract staff, and referral sources, while proactively responding to inquiries, resolving concerns, and maintaining accurate information to support efficient coordination of patient care services.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPSONSIBILITY**

  

* Direct and manage all daily patient referral, intake, and scheduling operations, including oversight of intake policies, procedures, and workflow efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with all state, federal, Medicare, and Joint Commission regulatory requirements related to intake, scheduling, and service delivery.
* Coordinate seamless patient transitions to home care by overseeing patient intake, education, plan of care initiation, and collaboration with multiple service providers.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

QUALITY MANAGER Custom Plastic Injection Molding | Medical Manufacturing

**Location: Livermore, California**

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Quality Manager** to lead and maintain our ISO 13485 Quality Management System in a growing, fast-paced custom plastic injection molding manufacturing environment.

Reporting directly to the President, the Quality Manager will oversee quality systems, compliance, inspection and testing, customer and supplier quality, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. This individual will lead and develop a three-shift quality team while ensuring products consistently meet customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and established quality standards.

The ideal candidate has direct experience managing an ISO 13485-certified Quality Management System and a deep understanding of FDA requirements—and understands how to build a culture of accountability, risk-based decision-making, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Management System & Regulatory Compliance**

* Lead the maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's ISO 13485 Quality Management System.
* Maintain the documented quality system, including procedures, records, document control, training, and change management.
* Oversee Management Reviews, quality objectives, performance metrics, and QMS effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate quality-system controls are established for risk management, process validation, and production activities.
* Maintain awareness of applicable FDA requirements and other relevant regulatory and customer requirements.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee nonconformance reporting (NCR), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause investigations, and effectiveness verification.
* Analyze customer complaints, nonconformance trends, scrap, rework, and other quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate structured problem-solving and preventive action initiatives.
* Monitor corrective actions and ensure timely, effective resolution.

**Audits & Customer/Supplier Quality**

* Plan, coordinate, and host customer, registrar, and other applicable quality audits.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for customer and auditor questions regarding quality-system requirements.
* Manage customer complaints and corrective action responses, ensuring timely, accurate, and complete communication.
* Oversee supplier quality performance, monitoring, corrective actions, and periodic reevaluation in coordination with Purchasing.
* Work directly with customers and suppliers to resolve quality issues and negotiate appropriate corrective actions.

**Inspection, Testing & Measurement**

* Manage inspection, testing, measurement, and product acceptance activities.
* Ensure measuring and monitoring equipment is appropriately controlled, calibrated, and maintained.
* Oversee the use of CMMs, micrometers, calipers, and other inspection equipment.
* Apply statistical process control and capability analysis, including Cpk and Gauge R&R, as appropriate.
* Support engineering changes (ECOs), controlled process deviations, and related quality records.

**Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead, coach, and develop the three-shift quality team, establishing clear expectations, responsibilities, and performance standards.
* Ensure employees are adequately trained and verify training effectiveness.
* Partner with Engineering, Purchasing, and Operations to resolve quality issues and improve manufacturing processes.
* Support new product introduction and the transition from development to production.
* Maintain clear accountability: Quality provides independent oversight, verification, and guidance, while Engineering, Purchasing, and Operations retain ownership of their respective processes and technical decisions.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum of **5 years of quality operations experience** in a production or manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing an **ISO 13485 Quality Management System**, including responsibility for QMS effectiveness, audits, CAPA, nonconformances, and Management Reviews.
* Strong working knowledge of root cause analysis, risk management, corrective action, and preventive action.
* Experience managing internal and external audits and responding to customer quality requirements.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, procedures, specifications, and regulatory documentation.
* Experience with inspection and measurement tools, including CMMs, micrometers, calipers, and related equipment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Demonstrated leadership, employee training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently while contributing effectively to a team.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
* Two or more years of experience as a Quality Supervisor, Quality Manager, or in a comparable leadership role.
* Experience in custom plastic injection molding, medical device manufacturing, or another regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience with process validation, statistical process control, process capability studies, and Gauge R&R.
* Familiarity with applicable FDA quality requirements and customer-specific regulatory expectations.

* Identifies personnel, institutional and material resources needed to accomplish program management objectives. Develops and present annual budgetary requirements for assigned environmental program operations.
