jobs.title: Customer Account Manager - Mid Market
jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

**About the team**

We are seeking a **Customer Account Manager** who is deeply committed to customer success and passionate about guiding them through every stage of their journey, driving meaningful outcomes and lasting partnerships.

The Account Management Team plays a key role in supporting HackerRank's growing customer base by partnering with small and mid-sized businesses as they adopt and scale their technical hiring processes. The team focuses on delivering consistent value through repeatable account motions, strong customer relationships, and reliable renewal execution. We are a collaborative, driven group that takes pride in helping customers succeed at scale.

**About the role**

We are seeking a Customer Account Manager who is committed to delivering a strong customer experience and supporting customers throughout their lifecycle with HackerRank. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of Mid Market customers, ensuring consistent adoption, smooth renewals, and a positive overall experience. You will collaborate closely with teammates and follow established playbooks to support retention and identify straightforward expansion opportunities, with guidance from senior team members.. This position is Full-Time and Hybrid in Santa Clara, CA.

**What you'll do**

* Manage a portfolio of Mid Market customers, executing defined adoption and renewal motions to drive retention and customer satisfaction.
* Conduct regular customer check-ins to ensure customers are realizing value and address questions or issues proactively.
* Support renewal conversations and standard contract processes, escalating complex scenarios as needed.
* Act as a strategic advisor by leading customer and internal teams, removing roadblocks, and accelerating adoption.
* Identify basic expansion or usage opportunities and partner with senior team members when appropriate.
* Maintain accurate customer data, renewal tracking, and activity logging in CRM tools.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Support to ensure a smooth and consistent customer experience.

**Who you are**

* You bring 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role within a SaaS or technology environment, such as account management, customer success, or technical support.
* You are organized, resilient, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* You are customer-focused and curious, motivated by understanding customer needs and ensuring a positive, reliable experience.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts and solutions into clear, accessible language for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain concepts clearly.

**Even better if you have**

* Familiarity with HR Tech, recruiting tools, or developer-focused products.
* Comfort engaging with day-to-day customer contacts in Engineering teams.
* A collaborative mindset. You work seamlessly across teams, bringing together Support, Product, and Sales to ensure customer needs are met.
* Nice to have: Prior software development experience or an academic background in computer science.

**You will thrive in this role if you**

* Demonstrates high agency, takes ownership, and proactively drives work forward with minimal oversight.
* Are a Captain - you enjoy owning the customer relationship and championing their success.
* Are skilled at engaging HR/Talent & Technical decision-makers, helping them navigate hiring and workforce planning goals.
* Believe in long-term partnerships and being the trusted advisor for your customers.

Current OTE range: 140,000-160,000. The exact salary may vary based on skills, experience, location, market ranges, and other compensation offered. The salary range does not include other benefits such as benefits for which you may be eligible. Salary may be adjusted based on business needs.

jobs.title: RCM Operations Specialist, Infusion (AI Platform)
jobs.description:
**About Trellis**  
Trellis builds AI that handles intake, benefits, prior authorization and reimbursement for infusion and specialty pharmacy providers, so patients start therapy faster and providers get paid for it.

**The role**  
You will be our expert on infusion prior authorization and reimbursement. Our system reads referrals, clinical notes and payer policies, then prepares the work that intake and reimbursement teams do by hand today. Your job is to make sure that work is right. You will review real cases across our customers, catch what the system gets wrong and explain why. Then you turn that judgment into rules and test cases our engineers build on. You will work directly with the product and engineering team.

**What you will do**

* Review prior authorization and reimbursement cases for infusion customers, covering benefits, coverage, PA requirements, medical necessity, billing codes and units
* Check each decision against payer policies, Medicare LCDs and NCDs, payer portals and the patient's clinical documentation
* Build answer keys that record the correct outcome for real cases, with the reasoning and source behind each call
* Find patterns in errors and write them up clearly for product and engineering, with examples
* Keep a working library of payer rules, drug coverage criteria and billing conventions up to date
* Learn how customer intake and reimbursement staff handle edge cases, and bring those conventions into the product
* Review early output during customer onboarding and flag risk before it reaches a claim

**What you bring**

* 3+ years in infusion or specialty pharmacy revenue cycle, such as prior authorization, benefits verification, billing, denials or appeals
* Working knowledge of medical versus pharmacy benefit, buy and bill, HCPCS J codes, administration CPT codes, NDC to billing unit conversion and modifiers
* Comfort reading LCDs, NCDs and commercial medical policies and applying them to a specific patient
* Experience with payer portals and PA tools such as Availity or CoverMyMeds, and pharmacy or infusion systems such as CPR+ or WellSky
* Careful judgment. You know the difference between what the chart says and what someone assumed
* Clear writing. You can explain a denial risk in two sentences to someone who has never billed a claim

**Nice to have**

* A CPC, CPB, CRCS or similar certification, or a pharmacy technician or nursing background
* Experience at a home infusion provider, ambulatory infusion center or specialty pharmacy
* Experience with biologics, IVIG and other high cost therapies across Medicare, Medicaid and commercial plans
* Curiosity about how AI can change healthcare operations. No coding required

**About the interview**
-----------------------

* **Intro call with Ahmed (30 min).** Your background, the kind of reimbursement work you have done, and what you want next.
* **Case review exercise (60 to 90 min).** We share two or three anonymized infusion referrals with the relevant payer policy. You decide whether a PA is needed, whether the case meets coverage criteria, and how it should be billed. Then we go through your reasoning together. We care more about how you think and where you look than about a perfect answer.
* **Team conversations (45 min).** Meet the people on product and engineering you will work with every day, and ask anything about how we build.
* **References and offer.** We move quickly and will tell you where you stand after each step.

Compensation Range: $70K - $120K

* Advocate for participants' rights and support their involvement in self-advocacy and personal decision-making.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is a natural mentor who is dependable, adaptable, organized, and committed to helping others reach their full potential.

You should be someone who:

jobs.title: Global Network BMCC Committee Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Global Network BMCC Committee Program Manager provides hands-on project management, coordination and operational support for the BMCC committee and related network priorities. Working with leaders and colleagues across US and Group member firms, this role helps translate committee direction into organized workplans, well-prepared meetings, clear action items and timely follow-through. The role also provides production support for select communications, business development, events and shared resources connected to committee priorities. The ideal candidate is an early-to-mid-career professional who communicates clearly, manages details well and is comfortable coordinating multiple workstreams in a collaborative global environment.

**What You Will Do:**

* Maintain annual committee calendars, forward agendas and workplans; coordinate recurring meetings and working sessions; and help ensure priorities, milestones and dependencies are visible and actively managed.
* Build agendas, briefing materials, presentations and meeting decks; coordinate inputs, version control and final review; document decisions and action items; and follow up with owners to support timely completion.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, status reports, decision logs, action trackers and shared files for committee-sponsored initiatives; identify risks, gaps and dependencies; and escalate issues when needed.
* Serve as a central point of coordination across committee members, workstream leads and BMCC colleagues across the US and Group; schedule working sessions, gather inputs and keep stakeholders informed of progress, decisions and upcoming deadlines.
* Assist with building, organizing and maintaining a central library of tender materials, credentials, case studies and reusable content; help ensure materials are current, clearly labelled and easy to find.
* Track agreed priorities, milestones and KPIs; maintain basic reports or dashboards; and compile recurring updates for committee and network leadership.
* Coordinate production of committee and network updates from planning through distribution, including gathering inputs, drafting and editing copy, managing reviews and maintaining the production schedule.
* Gather information from stakeholders and write concise stories that showcase significant client wins, cross-border collaboration and network capabilities in support of BMCC and Go-To-Market (GTM) priorities.
* Assist with planning and delivering committee-sponsored events, webinars, conferences and network meetings, including invitations, materials, speaker coordination, logistics and post-event follow-up.
* Make routine updates to approved global web content and shared resources, check information for accuracy and consistency, and help keep links, files and reference materials current.
* Provide additional coordination, communications and production assistance for BMCC, GTM and other network priorities as needs evolve.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, project management, communications, marketing or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Three to four years of experience in a program coordination, project management or committee support role, preferably within a global, business development, GTM or professional services environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage workplans, deadlines, dependencies, files, reviews and multiple assignments.
* Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to turn stakeholder input, meeting discussions and complex information into clear, concise materials.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word and Excel; experience with collaborative project management or document-sharing tools is helpful.
* Experience in leveraging AI and other productivity tools to improve efficiency, coordination and outcomes.
* Comfort working with senior leaders and colleagues across functions, geographies and time zones.
* Professional judgment and discretion when handling committee materials, leadership discussions and business information.
* Experience in a B2B or professional services environment

---------------------------------------------

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

jobs.description:
**About Scene Health**

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication non-adherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

**Operations Manager**
======================

**Department:** Patient Solutions

**Reports To:** VP of Operations

**Preferred Shift:** 12 pm - 8 pm (EST), rotating Saturday shifts as needed

**About the Role**
------------------

Scene Health is formalizing a new Operations Manager role to own the performance and compliance of our daily operations, including operational logistical planning, workflow management, and improving the efficiency and quality of our work across our telephony system and proprietary software. This role sits at the intersection of functional administration of the call center system, workforce management, and quality assurance — ensuring our Activation, Pharmacy, and Clinical Operations teams have the tools, training, and processes to reach patients efficiently and compliantly.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience administering TalkDesk (or a comparable contact center platform), is comfortable owning metrics and reporting, and can translate operational pain points into system-level solutions. Additionally, this role requires direct interaction with frontline team members to deliver metrics, feedback, and information to them for performance management.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Technology Operations & Functional Use**

* Serve as day-to-day lead for TalkDesk operational use, including user/permission setup, troubleshooting, issue escalation, reporting, and campaign management
* Lead process improvement projects within TalkDesk to enhance Activation, Pharmacy, and Clinical Operations performance for inbound, outbound, and warm-transfer calling
* Identify and implement automation opportunities for QA scoring, call disposition, phone number testing, and reporting workflows within TalkDesk and other operational systems
* Collaborate with Patient Solutions, Product, and Engineering teams to translate operational needs into technical requirements and delivery timelines; work with the tech team to review builds and configurations
* Set up and monitor new client campaigns and outreach efforts
* Develop and maintain outreach/call lists, improve reach rate for our outbound services, and drive automation improvements in list-building across all Patient Solutions departments
* Lead pre-launch configuration of internal telephonic systems and workflows and provide hands-on post-launch support, including outreach list creation and documentation of client-specific processes

**Operational Performance & Quality Assurance**

* Own and report on core operational KPIs, including:
* + 99.5% uptime of the call center platform and call lists
  + Reach rate
  + Average Handle Time (AHT)
  + Calls per Agent
  + Schedule Adherence
  + Occupancy rate
  + QA/compliance score, weighted for HIPAA and TCPA adherence
  + CSAT for the call center function
  + Call disposition accuracy
  Productivity on core operational metrics
* Conduct call and video engagement QA and document feedback; collate findings into continuous improvement initiatives for training, onboarding, campaign setup, and system readiness
* Implement QA processes and performance tracking to monitor platform efficiency and user/patient experience
* Build and maintain reporting on call center usage and metrics for Patient Solutions leadership

**Workforce & Campaign Management**

* Manage call center headcount planning and campaign scheduling
* Support workforce planning and outreach allocation based on volume forecasting and campaign metrics
* Support performance tracking and management across Patient Solutions teams, including setting up data analyses and automated reporting systems.

**Training & Enablement**

* Develop and deliver training on technical systems, computer configuration, and call disposition processes for frontline and calling teams
* Design and deliver user training sessions for new technology rollouts and system enhancements
* Document client-specific processes and departmental workflows to support scalability and regulatory compliance
* Conduct shadowing sessions and leverage analytical processes/tools to understand areas for improvement and ensure best use

**Vendor Management & Process Improvement**

* Contribute to vendor relationships and software optimization for TalkDesk and related calling infrastructure; schedule and lead vendor meetings as needed
* Support the design and standardization of departmental processes and documentation to ensure scalability and regulatory compliance
* Serve as an escalation point for complex call center issues, coordinating with cross-functional teams as needed

**What You'll Bring**

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**

On the Provider Operations team, we are responsible for credentialing the providers and facilities contracting with our health plan. We built our credentialing program from the ground up, and it credentials providers compliantly in industry-leading timeframes. That lets us build new networks quickly, show operational excellence to our providers, and keeps provider data current and accurate.

In our stage of growth, we are focused on implementing AI initiatives and expanding the responsibilities of our offshore team to make our operations faster, more efficient, and ready to scale. We’re looking for a Manager of Provider Operations who is a hands-on operator. You’ll be just as comfortable digging into work queues and untangling a messy case as you are redesigning a workflow or rethinking how a process could run with AI. Priorities will shift, and you’ll shift with them.

This is an ideal role for a results-driven leader who is mission driven, process oriented, data obsessed, and energized by change.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

* Supporting day-to-day credentialing operations, including working queues yourself, unblocking complex cases, and driving best-in-class turnaround times and quality.
* Leading the effort to capture our operational knowledge in clear, usable SOPs and building a central documentation library that stays current as processes change.
* Helping manage and develop our offshore team, including training, documentation, and quality and productivity monitoring, with the goal of owning the offshore relationship over time.
* Partnering on offshore transitions by identifying work that can move offshore and supporting smooth handoffs without disrupting turnaround times or compliance.
* Assessing operational pain points and using data to size opportunities and build the business case for new solutions using data insights, including quantifying the impact of AI solutions, tech improvements, and offshore transitions before and after they launch.
* Creating and implementing AI solutions that make operations more efficient and enable scale, partnering with product and engineering where needed and testing, measuring, and refining what you build.
* Playing a key role in our 2027 CVO vendor transition, including workflow mapping, requirements, testing, and cutover, and helping monitor vendor performance once live.
* Becoming an expert in our internal systems and tools so you can troubleshoot issues and propose clear improvements to system logic.
* Owning key operational metrics, building reporting that surfaces trends and bottlenecks, and using data to guide decisions.
* Ensuring credentialing operations remain compliant with CMS, AAAHC, and state requirements as processes and tools evolve.
* Partnering cross-functionally with internal leadership, network and contracting teams, providers, vendors, and offshore partners.

***Required skills and experience:***

* 3-5+ years in operations, process improvement, or consulting.
* A true operator with a bias toward action. You’re willing to roll up your sleeves and do the work, not just direct it.
* A clear head for process. You’re passionate about efficiency and can predict and prevent bottlenecks before they happen.
* Comfort moving quickly between big-picture strategy and detailed, in-the-weeds execution.
* Ability to shift focus and reprioritize quickly in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* You run toward complexity and have the stamina for hard problems.
* Detail-oriented, with a high bar for quality and accuracy.
* Ability and desire to understand and follow complex regulations.
* Strong communicator who can work with cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment.
* Data, systems, and tech savvy, with the ability to build reporting that improves decision-making.

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Healthcare experience.
* Familiarity with credentialing standards and CMS requirements.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying AI tools to improve workflows, or a strong track record of applying technology and automation to operational problems.
* Experience with process improvement methodologies.

***Salary Range:*** $73,000-$115,000/year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

* Generous paid time off

* Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles
* Parental leave program
* 401K program

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

**THE ROLE**

Zeta Global is looking for an experienced and proactive Client Experience Operations Manager to support the delivery of media dashboards and audience creation (1PD and pixel) across multiple client accounts. This role requires strong project coordination skills, attention to detail, organization, a deep understanding of digital media performance, and hands-on familiarity with tagging and pixel tracking technologies. You’ll work closely with Strategic Directors, analytics teams, and operations to ensure that tracking infrastructure is in place to provide accurate, actionable media insights across diverse verticals. Our main job function is to project manage various deliverables for our agency clients.

*Depending on your location, this role could be hybrid (NYC, Nashville, LA, San Francisco) or fully remote in this US.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Multi-Account Project Management**

* Support the Program Director on end-to-end project execution for media dashboard builds and enhancements across a portfolio of client accounts.
* Develop and maintain timelines, deliverables, and status documentation across multiple workstreams simultaneously.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between internal teams (media, analytics, ops and sales) and clients for tracking- and dashboard-related deliverables.
* Anticipate and manage resource constraints and shifting client priorities in a fast-paced setting

**Media Attribution & Tracking Oversight**

* Collaborate with the ops and analytics teams to ensure proper tagging and tracking is in place to execute projects
* Oversee the implementation and validation of pixels/tags across media platforms and client web properties using tools like Google Tag Manager or Adobe
* Coordinate with third-party vendors/agencies (e.g., Meta, DV360, TikTok, Campaign Manager 360) to ensure accurate data flows and media tracking.

**Dashboard Planning & Execution**

* Translate client reporting needs into data requirements and dashboard specifications.
* Potentially work with BI or data visualization teams to build or customize dashboards in tools such as Looker, Datorama, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Maintain QA processes to ensure data integrity and proper attribution across channels (paid search, paid social, display, video, programmatic, etc.).
* Manage versioning and enhancements as campaign needs evolve.

**Stakeholder Communication**

* Facilitate client communications for project milestones, data readiness, and dashboard walkthroughs.
* Document tagging requirements and dashboard logic for cross-functional transparency.
* Quarterback the internal communication between the teams (sales, data cloud, analytics, ops) to ensure projects are completed on time

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or Data/Analytics-related field; project management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile) is a plus.
* 3–5 years of project management experience, with at least 2 years in a marketing/advertising agency environment.
* Understanding of digital media channels (SEM, display, social, programmatic, video) and attribution mechanics.
* Familiarity with **tag/pixel management platforms** and third-party tracking integrations (GTM, Adobe Launch, Campaign Manager, Meta, etc.).
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with an ability to manage timelines across multiple stakeholders and projects.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Exposure to multiple attribution models and how they apply to client KPIs.
* Experience working with marketing analytics platforms (GA4, Adobe Analytics, CM360).
* Understanding of UTM parameters, conversion events, and media taxonomy standards.

**What You'll Bring to Zeta:**

* The ability to juggle multiple client projects without sacrificing quality or clarity.
* A proactive approach to solving tracking or data discrepancies before they become client issues.
* A collaborative spirit that helps media, analytics, and ops teams stay in sync.
* An eye for clean, clear reporting that connects media spend to measurable outcomes.

**BENEFITS & PERKS**

* Employee Equity and Stock Purchase Plan
* Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!

**SALARY RANGE**

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**

Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned-up industry.

**Vision Statement**

Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

**Mission Statement**

Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

**Core Values**

* We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency + feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth + learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions + work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative + open-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer + our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service + add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity + Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.

Ask five people on a product team why a launch slipped and you'll get five different partial answers: Engineering thought Product had locked scope, Product assumed Sales already knew what was changing, and Sales is finding out today, from a customer, that something they promised isn't shipping the way they described it. That gap between good people doing good work is where this job lives, and we need someone who can't stand leaving it open.

As the **Senior Product Operations Manager** at Assembly Software, you'd be the product manager for how our Product organization runs. Not a coordinator keeping a status doc updated, and not a process owner for its own sake, but someone who treats how our PMs, designers, and engineers plan, prioritize, launch, and learn as a product in itself, with real customers, real friction points, and real room to get better. You'll build the scorecards leadership can read without asking anyone for an update, run the readiness process that makes sure Sales and Customer Success know what's shipping before it ships, and use AI daily in how you actually work, not as a line in a strategy deck.

We're not hiring this role to keep the trains running on time; we already have that. We want someone who looks at how Product, Engineering, and Design work together and can't help but see exactly what's slowing them down, then goes and fixes it, whether or not it was technically their job. You'll move comfortably between a spreadsheet and a hard conversation with a VP about why a process needs to change, and you'll know when to retire your own mechanism because it's stopped earning its place.

jobs.title: Client Success & Implementation Manager ($65-85k - Remote)
jobs.description:
Tired of watching great ideas never get implemented?

You've worked with business owners who have big goals, great ideas, and plenty of opportunities.

But there's always a problem. Nobody actually makes things happen.

Projects stall. Employees don't follow through. Systems never get implemented. The owner ends up doing everything themselves.

**You're the person who fixes that.**

You love taking something from idea to execution. You've built systems, managed people, solved operational problems, and made businesses run better.

And you're looking for an opportunity where you can take real ownership instead of just managing tasks.

**That's exactly who we're looking for.**

The Opportunity

At PestLaunch, we help pest control business owners grow more profitable, scalable companies.

We work directly with owners to improve their sales, hiring, operations, finances, and overall business performance.

Our founder develops the strategy.

**You'll own making it happen.**

We're hiring someone to take ownership of our entire client success and fulfillment experience.

Not just answering questions. Not just checking in. Not just updating project boards.

**Actually driving results.**

You'll work directly with business owners, lead implementation, coordinate our team, and make sure clients consistently move forward.

This is a chance to take ownership of a major function inside a growing company, work closely with the founder, and help build something you can be proud of.

What You'll Do

**Own Client Success**

* Build strong relationships with our clients.
* Lead onboarding, communication, and client accountability.
* Own client satisfaction, retention, and renewals.
* Understand each client's business, goals, and priorities.

**Drive Implementation**

* Turn our founder's strategies into actionable plans.
* Build and implement business systems, processes, and campaigns.
* Coordinate our team and clients to get work completed.
* Manage milestones, deadlines, and deliverables.
* Identify problems, solve them, and keep projects moving.

**Own Results**

* Ensure clients are making measurable progress every week.
* Verify that systems are implemented and actually being used.
* Keep our founder informed and prepared without needing to be chased.
* Improve our fulfillment processes as the company grows.

**You won't have to personally do everything. But you'll own making sure everything gets done.**

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for an **experienced operator who's also great with people.**

You probably have 4+ years of experience in business operations, implementation, project management, client success, or a similar role.

Ideally, you've worked directly with business owners, managed people, built systems, and taken projects from start to finish.

You're someone who:

* Takes initiative without waiting for instructions.
* Understands business operations and how to improve them.
* Can juggle multiple clients, projects, and deadlines.
* Communicates clearly and builds trust quickly.
* Holds people accountable without damaging relationships.
* Solves problems independently.
* Cares more about results than activity.

Experience in home services, field services, consulting, or coaching is a plus.

**Pest control experience is NOT required.**

This Probably Isn't for You If...

* You need someone telling you what to do every day.
* You're better at organizing tasks than getting them completed.
* You avoid difficult conversations or accountability.
* You wait for problems to be brought to your attention.
* You prefer a narrow role with limited responsibility.

We're looking for someone who wants ownership, not just another job.

What You Get

* **$65,000–$85,000 annual salary**, depending on experience.
* Full-time, remote position.
* Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Mountain Time.
* Direct access to the founder.
* Real autonomy and responsibility.
* The opportunity to build and eventually lead a growing client fulfillment operation.
* The satisfaction of helping real business owners build better companies.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé and a Loom video answering these 4 questions:

**1.** Tell us about you. Sell us on why you're the person for this role.

**2.** Tell us about a business system or process you personally built and implemented. What was the result?

**3.** We care about getting our clients results. Tell us about times when you got clients results.

**4.** Why does owning both client relationships AND implementation appeal to you?

**We're looking for someone who gets things done.**

Pay: $65,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Field Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary
  
  
NVA is building a dedicated implementation capability to ensure operational improvements, process and policy enhancements, and other field-facing changes are deployed consistently, adopted effectively, and sustained across Field Operations and Hospitals as the business continues to scale.
  
  
The Field Implementation Manager is the execution arm of the Implementation & Enablement function for an assigned region. Reporting to the Sr Manager Implementation, this role activates non-medical, non-technology initiatives across Field Operations and Hospitals by turning approved direction into clear, practical action and supporting teams through deployment. The Field Implementation Manager is a trusted field-facing activator, listener, and trainer—distilling what matters for each audience, delivering effective training and communication, and helping leaders understand both the business need and what it means for day-to-day operations.
  
  
Working hand in hand with the Sr Manager Implementation, Operating Framework team, Support Center functions, Field leaders, and Hospital teams, this role ensures implementation plans are translated into successful activation at the hospital level. The Field Implementation Manager builds readiness, delivers training, reinforces adoption, listens for feedback and friction, and surfaces issues and pinch points early so implementations can land consistently, practically, and with efficacy.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Implementation & Activation
  
  

* Execute implementation plans for assigned non-medical, non-technology initiatives across an assigned region, ensuring the right actions happen at the right time and in the right sequence.
* Assess hospital readiness, including leader capacity, competing priorities, dependencies, required materials, training needs, and local operating realities.
* Coordinate activation activities with Field leaders and Hospital teams, maintaining alignment to enterprise expectations while adapting delivery to the needs of the audience.
* Partner with the Sr Manager Implementation to identify risks, gaps, dependencies, and readiness concerns before they become launch-day issues.
* Own the details required to move an implementation from 'ready' to 'activated,' including schedules, audiences, training, communications, support resources, and follow-up.

Training, Facilitation & Field Enablement
  
  

* Serve as a primary trainer and facilitator for assigned implementations, helping Field leaders and Hospital teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and what they need to do.
* Distill complex information into the most important, audience-relevant messages and teach in a way that is clear, engaging, practical, and easy to apply.
* Deliver training through appropriate channels, including live sessions, virtual training, leader meetings, office hours, huddles, and other field-facing forums.
* Use facilitator guides, job aids, FAQs, talking points, playbooks, SOPs, and other resources to reinforce consistent understanding and execution.
* Tailor training and communication to the audience without losing the intent, standards, or required outcomes of the implementation.

Communication & Business Translation
  
  

* Translate the business need behind an initiative into clear, practical messages that help Field and Hospital teams understand what is changing, why it matters, what action is required, and where to go for support.
* Partner with Support Center initiative owners and Communications partners to make implementation communications timely, relevant, concise, and actionable.
* Identify unclear, incomplete, or inconsistent messages and work with the Sr Manager Implementation and appropriate partners to resolve gaps before they create field confusion.

Listening, Feedback & Issue Resolution
  
  

* Act as a trusted listening post for Field and Hospital teams, capturing what is working, what is unclear, and where implementation friction is emerging.
* Surface questions, barriers, unintended impacts, and pinch points quickly, distinguishing between local questions and broader implementation risks.
* Help close the loop on feedback by clarifying recommended next steps, escalating patterns when needed, and reinforcing updates back to Field and Hospital teams.

Operating Framework & Cross-Functional Partnership
  
  

* Work closely with the Operating Framework team to ensure approved playbooks, SOPs, workflows, and operating standards are reflected accurately in implementation and training.
* Bring practical Field and Hospital perspective into planning so potential workflow, capacity, sequencing, or adoption challenges are understood before rollout.
* Maintain clear cross-functional handoffs among initiative owners, the Sr Manager Implementation, Operating Framework, Field leaders, and Hospital teams to keep related initiatives aligned and reduce competing demands on the field.

Adoption, Stabilization & Sustainment
  
  

* Monitor implementation progress and adoption within the assigned region using established KPIs, including training completion, readiness, utilization, compliance, feedback, and other available measures.
* Participate in audits, readiness checks, adoption reviews, and other mechanisms used to assess whether an implementation has landed effectively.
* Identify locations or teams that need additional support, reinforcement, retraining, or follow-up and coordinate targeted action.
* Support implementation stabilization by resolving open questions, reinforcing expected behaviors, and ensuring teams have the resources needed to operate consistently.
* Support transition to ongoing operational ownership once the implementation has stabilized, ensuring Field and Hospital leaders understand their ongoing responsibilities.

* Own or lead medical/clinical implementations, clinical training, or medical decision-making.

jobs.title: Delivery Operations Lead (3-Month Contract)
jobs.description:
Growth is a system rather than a collection of marketing services, and that belief is what earned Halstead Media Group a spot on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. We're a Growth Operations partner built specifically for the landscape industry, and our work spans demand generation, CRM, sales process, reporting and the connections between them, so that landscape companies can see how opportunities are created, moved through the pipeline and turned into revenue.

As our contract Delivery Operations Lead, you'll spend the next three months making sure every piece of client work, from websites and paid media to SEO, design, copy and reporting, has an owner, a realistic timeline and a budget that holds, so our team of about 30 can keep delivering at the standard our clients expect. The process and the tools are already in place, so this is a hands-on role for someone who loves bringing order to a busy queue and wants to be routing work and making priority calls from the first week. This position is 100% remote.

*Remote - Contract, about 25 hours a week*

**What you'll do day to day**
-----------------------------

* Own the intake queue in Scoro and assign every new task to the right person within one business day, so nothing sits without an owner
* Match work to people based on capacity, skill fit, priority, dependencies and budget
* Make sure every task is ready to start, with the brief, assets and approvals in place, before it reaches the team
* Keep one prioritized delivery queue across every client and department, and be the go-to answer for who is doing what and by when
* Set and adjust timelines based on real capacity and complexity, and bring tradeoff decisions about what moves, what waits and what gets re-scoped to our VP of Client Success
* Keep a live view of workload across project management, copy, design, development, SEO and paid media, and rebalance work as priorities and availability shift
* Track budgeted versus actual hours on active projects and flag anything trending over budget while there's still time to adjust
* Map handoffs from strategy to copy to design to development to launch, and clear bottlenecks by chasing decisions and re-sequencing work
* Run a short daily dispatch and triage huddle and a weekly delivery health review that sorts work into on track, at risk and off track, with a clear next action for each
* Escalate budget overages, timeline risks and blockers early, and stay with them until they're resolved
* Keep Scoro's statuses, queues and assignments clean, and deliver a weekly report on delivery performance, completed projects with budget versus actual, and timeline status
* Keep the delivery numbers on our company scorecard accurate and on time
* Work hand in hand with our Project Managers and department leads on priorities, client commitments, staffing and quality

**How you'll know you're doing an amazing job**
-----------------------------------------------

Every part of our delivery should contribute to the same goals and be measured against them, and this role is how the whole team keeps score.

* Every new task has an owner within one business day
* More of our work is delivered within its budgeted hours
* On-time delivery climbs, and launch dates hold
* Risks surface early, well before they touch a deadline or a client
* Weekly and monthly forecasts line up with what actually happens
* The weekly delivery report goes out on time, accurate and with clear next steps
* Project Managers and department leads come to you first when priorities collide
* The team says the queue feels calmer and clearer than it did when you started

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Experience running delivery operations, resourcing or traffic management at an agency or professional services firm
* A love for dispatching and load balancing across several teams at once, and the confidence to make fast prioritization calls
* Comfort tracking budget versus actual hours and forecasting capacity
* Hands-on experience with a work management platform such as Scoro, Asana, Monday, Teamwork or Workamajig, with Scoro a strong plus
* A calm, steady approach when priorities compete, and a knack for simple systems that people actually follow
* Comfort using AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day workflow
* **Bonus:** agency experience

**Contract details**
--------------------

* **Length:** about 3 months, starting as soon as possible
* **Hours:** about 25 hours a week, spread across weekdays so that dispatch happens daily
* **Type:** independent contractor (1099)
* **Location:** 100% remote, US based
* **Reports to:** Lauren Cullnan, VP of Client Success
* **Rate:** $32-$36/hour

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.

A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.

  

Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

InCommand is in daily use today across Serverfarm's own data centers and by the customers who operate in them. Behind it is the InCommand Operations team, our service desk: the people who bring every new site and customer onto the platform, keep its record of each facility accurate, support the teams who rely on it every day, and produce the reporting our customers depend on. That work carries on while the next generation of the product is built, and the operational knowledge this team holds is what the new product is built from.

As Ops Lead you manage that team and work alongside it. This is a hands-on management role: you know in detail how each of the team's processes works, from the way a new site is modeled to the way a customer request is resolved, and you can step into any of them yourself. You lead the implementation projects that bring new customers and sites onto the platform and serve as the customer's main technical contact while they run, and you grow the team as the business grows. You partner closely with Integrations and the development teams.

### **Key Accountabilities**

* Manage the InCommand Operations team day to day: set priorities, coach and develop each engineer, conduct performance reviews, and recruit as the team grows.

* Own the team's operating standards. Know every process in detail, keep the procedures documented and current, and make sure each new hire is trained to the same standard.

* Lead the onboarding of new customers and sites from kickoff through go-live, planning and scheduling each implementation, running the working sessions with the customer, tracking risks, reporting progress, and clearing whatever stands in the way.

* Build each site's record in InCommand from its construction documents and a walk of the floor: spaces, racks, the power path from utility to rack, cooling, devices and cross-connects, reconciled against what is actually installed. Prepare and load the bulk-upload worksheets, and work with Integrations to define and validate the telemetry points each site requires.

* Use AI assistants and automation to turn drawings, asset lists and field notes into structured, validated data, build repeatable extraction and validation workflows for the whole team, and audit existing site data to find and resolve discrepancies.

* Support Serverfarm sites and customers in their daily use of the platform: power capacity monitoring, space and rack layouts, device lifecycle and moves, adds and changes, ports and cross-connects and the billing that depends on them, CMMS asset tracking and preventive maintenance scheduling, walk-around checklists, critical spares, and monthly customer reporting. Train customers and site teams so that the service desk is their first call.

* Represent the users to the development teams: reproduce and document defects, write enhancement requests with clear acceptance criteria, test releases before they reach customers, and keep the help documentation current.

### **Required Skills**

* 5+ years in or around data centers (operations, critical facilities, IT infrastructure or DCIM), including 2+ years formally managing engineers or technicians, with responsibility for priorities, coaching, performance reviews and hiring.

* You have led projects end to end, coordinating with internal teams and external customers, owning scope, schedule, stakeholders and status.

* You have worked with SCADA systems (BMS and EPMS) and read and interpreted data center construction documents: single-line diagrams, floor plans, rack elevations and panel schedules.

* You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) every day to extract, structure and validate data, and you have built prompts and automations.

* You have strong data skills: advanced Excel and Power Query, SQL, and structured formats such as CSV and JSON.

* You communicate plainly, lead customer working sessions with confidence, and explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.

* You work hard problems through to resolution on your own initiative, and you bring a specific question when you need help.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Worked with a DCIM, DCFM or CMMS platform (Nlyte, Sunbird, Hyperview, MCIM or similar).

* Written scripts in Python or PowerShell and worked with REST APIs.

* Supported colocation customers directly, including their reporting and billing data.

* Earned an ITIL or PMP certification.

### **Compensation**

**COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION PACKAGE BETWEEN SALARY, BONUS + BENEFITS**

Serverfarm is committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace and offers paid time off, paid holidays, 401k and FULL coverage medical, dental and vision. Our compensation philosophy rewards employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned with the company’s goals and strategic initiatives.

The listed salary range for this position is an estimate based on the competitive job market. Final compensation will be based on your own individual skill

We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking an experienced Implementation Specialist to lead client implementations of Procurement Solutions, which includes CostCheck, ShortageCheck and 340BCheck. CostCheck, our pharmacy purchasing and cost-savings optimization solution. CostCheck helps hospitals maximize pharmacy savings opportunities by monitoring spend against savings caps, GPO contract terms, and 340B program requirements. ShortageCheck predicts hospital and pharmacy drug shortages up to 90 days in advance, using market-wide signals — fulfillment delays, demand surges, usage trends — from over 3,250 healthcare organizations to give your team the lead time to plan ahead instead of scrambling once patient care is at risk. 340BCheck340BCheck unifies 340B data in one compliance command center, built on real HRSA audit requirements, so hospitals and grantees stay continuously audit-ready as their program grows. As a member of the team, this person will manage the most complex implementations — configuring systems to maximize potentials and fill gaps , and setting customers up on sound methodology from day one — act as a trusted advisor to customers' purchasing and pharmacy leadership, and help mentor other Implementation Specialists on purchasing-, supply- and cost-related workflows.

**Job Location**  
  
Remote - must reside and work legally in the U.S. All work must be performed within the U.S.

**About CCU**

Colorado Christian University is the premier interdenominational Christian university in Colorado and the Rocky Mountain region, delivering world class education to thousands of students. The fully accredited, nonprofit university is located in Lakewood, Colorado, a suburb of Denver.

Colorado Christian University was founded in 1914. CCU’s motto is grace and truth. This motto comes from John 1.14: “And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen His glory, the glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth,” (ESV).

CCU's mission is Christ-centered higher education transforming students to impact the world with grace and truth.

Colorado Christian University cultivates knowledge and love of God in a Christ-centered community of learners and scholars, with an enduring commitment to the integration of exemplary academics, spiritual formation, and engagement with the world. We envision graduates who think critically and creatively, lead with high ethical and professional standards, embody the character and compassion of Jesus Christ, treasure the gospel, and who thereby are prepared to impact the world in their callings.

CCU embraces an educational model that was present at the foundation of many of the great Western and American universities. It is made up of three pillars — competence, character, and Christ-centered faith. Secular universities have abandoned two of those pillars. A leader in higher education, CCU has been consistently ranked in the top 2% of colleges and universities nationwide for its core curriculum by the American Council of Trustees and Alumni. CCU has had 11 consecutive years of enrollment growth and has been named one of the five fastest-growing master’s granting universities by *The Chronicle of Higher Education.*

CCU offers more than 200 degree program options for traditional and adult students through its two colleges — the College of Undergraduate Studies and College of Adult and Graduate Studies. More than 17,000 students attend the University on the main campus, online, and through CCU Academy.

**What is most appealing about working at CCU?**

* Faith-friendly: CCU’s culture is unique to higher education. Where else can you pursue academic excellence yet read the Holy Bible, pray with teammates and students at work, and work to impact our culture in support of Christian values?
* Convictionally Christian: As a university, we have an enduring commitment to Christ, His kingdom and the truth of God’s Word.
* Live out your calling: We are a traditional evangelical university where you can invest your God-given talents and abilities alongside coworkers and teammates, while having a profound influence on students as they deepen their relationship with Jesus Christ.
* Equip students for kingdom work: You can be a part of helping students discover their callings and preparing them for positions of significant leadership in the church, business, government, education, and other professions, as a key part of our University's Strategic Priorities.

**We’re looking for candidates who have:**

* A bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, business, journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience, is required.

* A solid commitment to building and fostering collaborative relationships with internal clients, designers, project managers, vendors, and other CCS staff.

jobs.title: Clinical & PACS Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Engagement Overview

The Contractor bridges client facilities, clinical staff and technology systems. Working with the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations as the primary point of contact, the Contractor provides daytime PACS administration, clinical client and physician coordination, and physician scheduling support.

The Contractor also anchors after-hours support by covering a light on-call rotation (1 week in every 6) and serving as the technical escalation resource for the after-hours administration team. Services outside this scope are added only by mutual written agreement.

Scope of Services

The Contractor is responsible for the results below and determines the methods, sequence and tools used to deliver them.

1. PACS Administration & Technical Support

* Provide daytime administration of the Company's PACS platforms, including study routing, verification and uninterrupted diagnostic workflow.
* Resolve study matching errors, Sirona tickets, missing prior studies and image quality tickets.
* Work with PACS/IT vendors, modality technologists and reading physicians to resolve modality worklist failures, hanging protocol errors and viewer discrepancies.
* Monitor study queues across all clinical feeds so turnaround-time SLAs are consistently met.

2. Clinical Client & Physician Liaison

* Act as a primary operational contact for clients, referring providers and the Company's radiologists on report turnaround, stat read coordination and protocol questions.
* Support physician scheduling, including complex specialty exam schedules, add-on reads and subspecialty physician assignments.
* Facilitate direct communication between referring clinicians and on-duty radiologists.
* Track recurring client issues, report them to the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations with recommended service improvements, and maintain client preference cards.

3. Escalation Support & After-Hours On-Call

* Provide primary after-hours on-call coverage 1 week in every 6, handling urgent intake and technical issue resolution.
* Serve as the daytime technical escalation point for the after-hours administration team, including knowledge transfer on PACS troubleshooting.
* Deliver updates to standard operating procedures (SOPs), after-hours call sheets, PACS troubleshooting playbooks and FAQs.

Coverage Commitments

The Contractor commits to two coverage windows; within them, the Contractor sets their own working hours and methods.

* **Business-day coverage:** Available to respond to client, physician and PACS issues Monday–Friday during core business hours.
* **On-call coverage:** Primary after-hours on-call 1 week on, 5 weeks off, on a rotation calendar agreed in advance with the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations. The Contractor may arrange a swap with another qualified rotation member, with notice.

Contractor Qualifications

* **Experience:** 5+ years in medical imaging, healthcare administration or clinical operations. Direct radiology operations experience, including PACS workflows, is required.
* **Technical knowledge:** Strong command of PACS workflow, HL7 messaging flows, imaging modalities (CT, MRI, X-ray, US) and HIPAA compliance standards.
* **Communication:** Strong problem-solving and de-escalation skills. Able to translate technical PACS problems into plain clinical terms for providers and to coordinate respectfully with physicians and clients.
* **Availability:** Able to cover the after-hours remote on-call rotation on a 1-week-on, 5-weeks-off cycle.
* **Business setup:** Operates as an independent business with their own phone and reliable internet connection. The Company provides a secured computer for HIPAA compliance.

Engagement Terms

These terms summarize the Independent Contractor Agreement; the signed agreement governs.

* **Independent status:** The Contractor is not an employee and is not eligible for Company benefits.
* **Fees and invoicing:** $70,000 annually, paid as $5,833.33 per month against a monthly invoice. On-call weeks are included in the fee.
* **Taxes and insurance:** The Contractor is responsible for their own income and self-employment taxes and any business licenses or insurance. The Company issues Form 1099-NEC annually.
* **Tools and workspace:** The Company provides a secured, HIPAA-compliant computer and credentials to the PACS and client-facing systems needed to perform the services. The Contractor provides their own phone, internet and workspace.
* **Other clients:** The Contractor may provide services to other businesses, as long as that work does not breach confidentiality, conflict with Company clients or interfere with the coverage commitments above.
* **HIPAA and confidentiality:** The Contractor signs a Business Associate Agreement and confidentiality agreement before receiving system access.

Pay: $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

Remote Pharmacy Technician & Patient Care Coordinator

**Comprehensive Care Pharmacy (CCRX) | Remote Position**

At Comprehensive Care Pharmacy (CCRX), we’re building a different kind of community pharmacy—one that combines traditional pharmacy services with proactive patient care, medication synchronization, chronic disease support, wellness, and exceptional old-fashioned customer service.

We’re looking for an experienced **Pharmacy Technician with an active Illinois Pharmacy Technician license** to join our team remotely.

This position is ideal for a technician who knows pharmacy workflow, genuinely enjoys talking with patients, and has **exceptionally strong hospitality instincts**. A major focus of the role will be Med Sync and proactive patient outreach, along with prescription processing, insurance troubleshooting, adherence packaging coordination, and patient care support.

Being remote does not mean being removed from our patients. **You will often be one of the voices of CCRX**, and we expect every interaction to leave patients feeling known, cared for, and confident that someone is taking ownership of what they need.

What You’ll DoPharmacy Technician & Workflow Support

* Process prescriptions and complete prescription data entry in PioneerRx
* Troubleshoot insurance rejects and prescription processing issues
* Support Med Sync and RapidPak/RapidCard workflows
* Communicate with patients, prescribers, insurance plans, and the in-store pharmacy team

* Assist with digital compounding records, documentation, and workflow preparation as appropriate

You may also be assigned a defined group of CCRX patients and help proactively manage their pharmacy and care needs.

* Following concerns through to resolution rather than simply passing along a message

**Hospitality Is a Core Part of This Job**

At CCRX, hospitality is not limited to the person standing at the pharmacy counter. It applies to **every phone call, every follow-up, and every patient interaction.**

We are looking for someone who naturally:

* Makes people feel welcomed, heard, and cared for
* Is warm and conversational while remaining efficient and professional
* Remembers that there is a person behind every prescription and task
* Takes ownership instead of repeatedly passing patients to someone else
* Looks for ways to make things easier for the patient
* Communicates clearly when something goes wrong and follows through until it is resolved
* Builds trust over time so patients recognize and value the relationship
* Understands that excellent service sometimes means doing the small extra thing that wasn't explicitly requested

Who Will Thrive in This Role

Just as importantly, you should be someone who **likes people**. You notice when a patient is confused. You ask the extra question. You remember what they told you last month. jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Insignia Federal Group is a woman-owned small business providing personalized consulting services to private and public sector clients. Its expertise includes professional IT services, program management, training, and acquisition support.

**Job Summary**

Insignia Federal Group is a professional consulting firm headquartered in McLean, Virginia. We have an excellent opportunity for a **Quality Assurance Analyst** to support a federal government client. This role involves ensuring the quality, accessibility, and usability of large-scale federal websites and web applications through manual and automated testing within an Agile delivery environment. The Quality Assurance Analyst should be detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable engaging early in the development cycle, reviewing requirements, building test cases before development is complete, and validating finished work against acceptance criteria. The successful candidate will work closely with business analysts, developers, UI/UX designers, and federal stakeholders to deliver reliable, standards-compliant digital experiences.

**Successful Candidate:**

**Test Planning & Requirements Analysis**

* 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance for web-based applications.
* Independently review user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, and UI/UX designs to identify test scenarios, missing requirements, dependencies, and potential risks.
* Develop and maintain organized test plans, suites, and test cases grouped by application functionality, features, and components, with traceability to Jira tickets and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare test cases proactively during backlog refinement and development, rather than waiting until features are ready for QA.
* Design positive, negative, and exploratory test scenarios to validate both documented requirements and unexpected application behavior.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts and developers to clarify ambiguities and ensure requirements are sufficiently testable before implementation is complete.

**Manual & Automated Testing**

* Perform hands-on functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end testing of web applications and interactive website functionality.
* Prioritize testing and retesting of active sprint deliverables to support code-freeze and release commitments.
* Designing and executing automated test scripts using tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks is a plus.
* Perform targeted regression testing after bug fixes to identify unintended impacts on related functionality.
* Validate functionality across browsers, devices, screen sizes, and user interaction scenarios.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking an AI Operations Specialist to help business and product teams use AI to take on review and quality work. You will map how work gets done today, build AI-driven workflows, and test them until the results can be trusted. You will also help product teams decide whether an AI feature is ready to launch. This is a hands-on role: you help build the workflow, ship it, and stay on to make sure it keeps working. The scope is expected to grow as AI capabilities evolve.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Help prioritize projects by business impact and make the case for the ones worth pursuing.
* Partner with process owners to map current workflows, then define where AI can do the work and where people step in on hard cases.
* Build AI workflows: write prompts, set up pipelines, maintain agreed quality levels, and monitor for drift after launch.
* Build test sets, measure accuracy, and calibrate LLM judges against human reviewers.
* Help product teams define launch-readiness criteria for AI features and provide evidence for go/no-go decisions.
* Turn unclear policy into criteria reviewers can apply consistently, working with product, legal, and policy partners.
* Work with subject matter experts to write labeling guidelines and produce human-verified labels on real data.
* Run labeling at scale with vendor agents, and validate their work using agreement metrics and spot checks.
* Make solutions reusable and document learnings so future teams reach production faster.
* Keep methods current as models, tools, and vendor agents change, and retire what no longer works.
* Own assigned workstreams end to end, from setup through quality checks.

### **Qualifications**

* 5-7 years in operations, program management, analytics, consulting, or applied AI, with accountability for results.
* Daily AI user who has built something with AI that delivered measurable impact, such as a workflow, an automation, or an analysis.
* Comfortable with metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and sampling.
* Experience taking a messy process and making it measurable.
* Quality experience in some form, such as review guidelines, QA, or audits.
* Clear writer, able to work with business leads, product managers, and engineers.
* Self-directed and comfortable working with limited direction.

jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager - Growth and Capture

Company: MMS

Location: Remote

Reports To: GM

Position Type: Full-Time

MTNT delivers mission-critical intelligence, cybersecurity, communications, technology solutions, and construction solutions to federal customers nationwide. Built on a legacy of service to Alaska Native people, we combine proven performance with an entrepreneurial spirit focused on the future. Our success is driven by strong teams who are united by integrity, collaboration, and a commitment to helping our clients accomplish their most important missions. At MTNT, employees are empowered to grow their careers, pursue excellence, and make a meaningful impact while enjoying a culture that values balance, opportunity, and shared success.

Overview:

MTNT is seeking an experienced, growth-oriented Senior Program Manager to lead business development, capture management, strategic partnerships, and program execution across the company’s federal services portfolio.

This position serves as the primary growth leader for the Services Division, responsible for identifying, qualifying, capturing, and transitioning federal opportunities into successful contract execution while strengthening existing programs and customer relationships. The successful candidate will work closely with executive leadership to expand MTNT's presence within the federal marketplace while supporting oversight and continuity for existing contracts and customer relationships.

The ideal candidate has a demonstrated record of federal business development success, strong customer and industry relationships, and executive presence necessary to engage government leaders, contracting officials, prime contractors, and strategic partners. This individual must be capable of creating opportunities, developing winning strategies, and positioning MTNT for sustained growth.

Key Responsibilities:

* Drive business development, capture management, strategic partnerships, and program execution across the federal services portfolio.
* Develop and execute growth strategies aligned with MTNT objectives.
* Build and maintain relationships with federal customers, contracting officials, industry partners, and key decision-makers.
* Lead capture planning, bid/no-bid reviews, proposal support, and transition to operations.
* Identify, assess, and qualify federal business opportunities consistent with MTNT capabilities growth goals.
* Develop teaming strategies and establish relationships that expand access to customers, contract vehicles, and new markets.
* Ensure compliance with all government contracting regulations and requirements.
* Provide leadership continuity and executive oversight for assigned contracts, customer relationships, and business operations, as needed.
* Support successful contract performance, customer satisfaction, and the transition of new awards into execution.
* Perform other strategic, operational, and leadership duties as assigned to support the growth and success of the Services Division.
* Provide leadership and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and positive work environment.

Qualifications:

* A bachelor's degree in a relevant field is required, and a master's degree is preferred.
* 10+ years federal contracting experience.
* Demonstrated business development and capture success.
* Strong understanding of FAR, DFARS, GWACs, IDIQs etc.
* Technical or professional services background preferred.
* Existing federal customer relationships strongly preferred.
* PMP, APMP, Shipley certifications and/or MBA.
* Security clearance preferred.

MTNT is an equal opportunity employer, including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* federal contracting: 10 years (Preferred)
* federal capture: 6 years (Preferred)
* federal proposal writing: 6 years (Preferred)
* business development: 6 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* PMP or similar certification (Preferred)

Security clearance:

* Secret (Preferred)
