jobs.title: Revenue Operations Lead, West
jobs.description:
**About Cogent Security**
-------------------------

Cogent is redefining vulnerability management with an AI native platform that helps security teams cut through the noise and fix what matters. We are backed by top tier investors, growing rapidly, and building the go to market engine to match.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Revenue Operations Lead, West sits on the GTM Strategy & Operations Team and owns the operating system for growth across the West region. You will partner with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, and our GTM Engineer to turn account intelligence, intent, competitive activity, event engagement, and product signals into coordinated plays that create and accelerate pipeline.

This role can be fully remote, though we have a strong preference for someone based in San Francisco who wants to work from our HQ a few days each week. The work spans strategy and execution. One day you may build a regional account plan and conversion model; the next you may launch an automated campaign, brief sellers for an event, or improve the system that routes the right signal to the right person.

A traditional marketing background is not required. We are looking for a launch and scale operator: someone who has led complex cross functional programs, built the operating system behind them, and can bring analytical and operational rigor to growth.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **Regional revenue strategy**

* Own the West revenue plan across target accounts, pipeline goals, market moments, and sales priorities.
* Refine the ICP and turn it into audiences, account tiers, and plays that the regional team can act on.
* Build a clear operating cadence with Sales so the team knows what is working, what needs attention, and what to do next.

### **Play design and execution**

* Design coordinated digital, lifecycle, outbound, partner, and field plays with a defined audience, trigger, sequence, and outcome.
* Run experiments quickly, measure the result, and decide what to stop, improve, or scale.
* Move comfortably from planning and analysis into hands on execution.

### **Systems and intelligence**

* Operate and improve the signal layer with our GTM Engineer across intent, engagement, competitive activity, account intelligence, and event interactions.
* Build practical workflows in HubSpot and adjacent tools for targeting, routing, nurture, follow up, and measurement.
* Use AI agents and automation to remove manual work, improve decision quality, and help the team act faster.

### **Field as a growth channel**

* Use dinners, conferences, partner programs, and other in person experiences as part of broader account plays.
* Identify the right accounts, brief sellers, coordinate execution, and ensure follow up converts engagement into pipeline.
* Measure program performance and feed the results back into future planning.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* Five or more years in program management, business operations, revenue operations, product operations, growth, or another cross functional operating role at a high growth technology company.
* A track record of taking complex initiatives from launch through scale. Experience coordinating teams across product, operations, sales, and technology is especially relevant.
* Strong systems thinking. You can map a process, find the friction, define the data needed, and work with technical partners to build a better system.
* Quantitative rigor and comfort using imperfect data to make practical decisions.
* Experience with CRM, automation, or go to market tools is helpful. Deep HubSpot administration is not required.
* AI native working habits and curiosity about building workflows with agents.
* High ownership, strong judgment, and a willingness to do the work yourself in a fast moving startup.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are at Our Core**

At Ecotrak, we truly care about making life easier for the people who keep facilities running. That’s why, through our SaaS product, we’re trying to change the way repair & maintenance is done – with more automated equipment tracking, proactive insights, and warranty execution.

We’re a team that believes in building strong relationships and getting things done right with our customers—facilities leaders, service providers, and everyone dedicated to keeping operations smooth and steady.

As we say around here, we care for the people using our technology just as much as we care about making it.

If you’re ready to join a crew of hard-working, down-to-earth people trying to rapidly change an industry for the better, you’ll fit right in.

**Your Role In Keeping Things Running:**

As a Customer Success Manager, you are the steady guide for customers after go-live—driving advocacy, translating their data into decisions, and keeping accounts healthy so operations run smoothly & operators become advocates.

Build long-term relationships with customers, serving as their primary point of contact.

**What You’ll Get Done:**

Build A Strong Partnership

* Build clear success plans that tie customer goals to Ecotrak capabilities & milestones
* Host regular check-ins and business reviews with customers – to gain feedback on the success plan & provide recommendations on how to improve
* Monitor account health, flagging risks early and mobilizing the right teams (internal or external) to resolve
* Get to know customers personally – building a connection outside of just the platform

Be the Strategic Project Manager & Data Storyteller

* Build presentations that turn product usage, work orders, and asset trends into ROI narratives leaders understand
* Tailor recommendations to fit the customer's reality—industry, footprint, workflows
* Send clean executive recaps with decisions, owners, and dates that keep momentum
* Develop a deep understanding of Ecotrak’s technology to provide best practices and strategic guidance

Coordinate Cross-Functionally & Improve the Machine

* Partner with Support to close loops on issues and reduce ticket re-opens
* Work with Product to relay prioritized feedback & requirements; track outcomes back to customers
* Identify expansion signals and renewal readiness in partnership with Sales
* Coordinate closely with the Implementation, Asset Survey, & Training teams during the client onboarding process
* Identify & create operational efficiencies that raise advocacy across your book of business
* Be the voice for the client internally

**What You’ll Bring to the Crew**

In experience:

* 3–7 years in a strategic client-facing role (i.e. CSM, Management Consulting, Strategic Accounts/Partnerships, multi-location Operations Manager)
* Proven ownership of a customer book: running exec-level meetings, multi-threading stakeholders, and guiding change
* Data storytelling chops: Excel/Sheets & dashboards to turn trends into business impact
* Strong organization & project management across multiple accounts
* Crisp written & verbal communication – able to tailor presentation styles to different stakeholder groups
* Familiarity with CRM and CS tooling (Hubspot/Salesforce, Gainsight/ChurnZero); basic business intelligence a plus
* Bonus: experience in B2B technology, restaurants, convenience, retail, facilities, or field-service environments

In intangibles:

* Professional presence with a “be real” communication style—clear, kind, and direct
* Ownership mindset: you follow through, unblock others, and get sh\*t done
* Teacher’s mindset: patient, approachable, and generous with know-how
* Willingness to experiment & improve the playbook; calm under pressure/ambiguity
* Problem-solving excitement with the ability to react & adapt

**Who You’ll Work With**

In this role, the *main* people you’ll be working with are:

* Customer Success Team Lead – who you’ll report to
* Customer Experience Team (i.e. Implementation, Support, Asset Surveys) – to keep customers moving along in their journey to advocacy
* Product Team - to relay feedback and close the loop on improvements
* Sales Team - to align on renewals, upsell opportunities, and account strategy

**Why You’ll Love Working With Us**

* You’ll work with down-to-earth people, always looking to help one another.
* You’ll work at a company where your growth is in your control – no politics here!
* Your work will directly impact the success & growth of the company – you’re not just a cog in the machine.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, FSA, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance
* 401(k) with 4% match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid holidays
* Company Swag & Team-building events
* Opportunities for career growth
* More listed at Ecotrak.com/careers

**Salary**: 100k - 120k

As part of our commitment to compliance with federal regulations, Ecotrak uses E-Verify to verify the employment eligibility of all employees.

We are a Veteran owned organization that takes pride in servicing our active service-members and Veterans. We currently have two companies that service military personnel and Veterans in a multitude of ways, United Shield Life Insurance and United Veteran Benefits Agency.

* Track and follow up with prospective clients through the lead conversion process.
* Provide quality customer service and maintain a positive rapport with all prospects and current clients.
* Develop and maintain an effective working relationship with the Veteran Benefits Specialists (VBS).
* Assist veterans with completing any required VA forms.
* Maintain the Salesforce CRM system.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Self-motivated.
* Proficient in Microsoft Suite and Adobe Acrobat.
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience in Salesforce preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to handle daily case management.
* Ability to present realistic recommended courses of action plans designed to assist clients and develop confidence in our brand.
* Possess an understanding of military culture and terminology.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to accurately complete tasks.
* Possess the ability to move a prospective client through the initial process necessary to become a client.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

Arryved, part of the Fullsteam organization, is a SaaS company specializing in Point-of-Sale solutions for the craft beverage and hospitality industry. From taprooms and brewpubs to mobile ordering and online sales, Arryved helps businesses deliver seamless customer experiences for passionate craft communities.

**Job Summary:**

The **Manager, Customer Support** leads the customer support team and is accountable for team performance, service delivery, and continuous improvement of support operations. This role translates department priorities into team goals, sets expectations, coaches and develops employees, and manages staffing and coverage to deliver consistent service from initial customer contact through resolution. The Manager uses support KPIs to identify performance gaps and drive improvements in service levels, workflows, and documentation. As the escalation owner for complex customer issues, the Manager guides resolution and engages directly when needed, while partnering with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to address customer feedback and prepare the team for product changes.

* Provide direct people leadership for the customer support team, including setting goals and expectations, assigning work, conducting regular one-on-ones, coaching performance, and fostering an accountable, inclusive, high-performing culture.
* Manage key aspects of the employee lifecycle for the team, including participating in interviews and selection, supporting onboarding, providing ongoing coaching and development, completing performance reviews, recognizing contributions, and addressing performance concerns.
* Establish team priorities, service standards, and operating rhythms; translate department goals into clear individual and team deliverables and hold the team accountable for results.
* Manage team capacity and coverage through staffing plans, schedules, on-call rotations, and holiday coverage. Assess workload against available capacity, adjust assignments and coverage to maintain service levels, and identify staffing gaps requiring leadership decisions.
* Own team performance against support KPIs, including response time, customer satisfaction (CSAT), first-contact resolution (FCR), ticket backlog, and quality. Review trends, identify root causes of performance gaps, implement team-level improvement plans, and communicate results and progress against service expectations.
* Monitor queues and team capacity, make real-time prioritization and resource-allocation decisions, and ensure timely, effective resolution of support tickets across all levels.
* Own the escalation-management process for high-impact, complex, or at-risk customer cases. Establish clear resolution ownership, coordinate the appropriate resources, and ensure timely customer communication, follow-through, and documented resolution; engage directly when the issue requires managerial intervention.
* Serve as the team’s technical and operational escalation point, guiding employees through ambiguous issues and determining when to involve Product, Engineering, Customer Success, or senior leadership.
* Lead support-operations improvements across processes, workflows, the knowledge base, quality assurance, and training. Prioritize opportunities using service data and customer feedback, guide implementation and team adoption, and evaluate whether changes improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Identify customer-risk patterns and partner with Customer Success and Sales on retention strategies and coordinated action plans.
* Represent the voice of the customer by synthesizing support trends and actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Sales, and other stakeholders.
* Lead support-team readiness for new features and product changes by coordinating employee training, documentation updates, and escalation planning with cross-functional partners. Identify readiness gaps before launch and use post-launch feedback to address support issues and improve future rollouts.

* Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including setting expectations, coaching employees, addressing performance concerns, developing talent, and creating accountability across a team.
* Sound judgment in balancing customer impact, employee capacity, service levels, and established business priorities in a fast-paced environment, including knowing when to escalate decisions or risks to senior leadership.
* Experience owning customer escalations with empathy, clarity, urgency, and disciplined follow-through.
* Demonstrated ownership of strategic support initiatives that improve efficiency, customer satisfaction, quality, and scalability.
* Ability to translate company objectives into measurable team goals, operating plans, and individual expectations.
* Strong analytical skills, including experience building or using dashboards, interpreting performance data, identifying root causes, and adjusting team priorities based on evidence.

At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run **30,000 programs**, welcomed **1.2 million applicants**, and facilitated the distribution of **more than $10 billion** in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.

We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. **About Mosai**

Mosai™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai, home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at https://www.mosai.com/

  

**Position Summary**

The Enterprise Account Manager at Mosai is responsible for driving significant revenue growth across a portfolio of strategic, high-value clients by identifying, developing, and closing complex expansion opportunities. This role operates as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, building deep, consultative partnerships and aligning Mosai’s solutions to long-term client objectives and organizational priorities. The Enterprise Account Manager leads sophisticated upsell, cross-sell and renewal motions, navigating multi-threaded buying groups and longer sales cycles, while collaborating closely with Client Engagement, Product, Training and Enablement, Revenue Operations and Marketing to deliver measurable business impact. This role owns the full expansion lifecycle—from strategic account planning and opportunity creation through negotiation and close—and is accountable for expansion ARR, net revenue retention, renewal, and strengthening Mosai’s position as a mission-critical partner.

  

**Job Duties:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive account plans to identify and accelerate expansion opportunities within a portfolio of enterprise clients
* Build and maintain senior-level relationships, including C-suite and executive stakeholders, to influence long-term growth and partnership strategy
* Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including discovery, value articulation, solution positioning, negotiation, and close

* Partner cross-functionally with Client Engagement, Product, and Marketing to shape account strategy, inform product direction, and deliver cohesive client experiences

* Proactively identify risks and opportunities within accounts to improve retention and unlock incremental revenue
* Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and account insights within CRM systems

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution
* 5–8+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, with a strong track record of success in enterprise SaaS and/or healthcare environments
* Proven ability to manage and grow large, complex accounts with multiple stakeholders and business units
* Demonstrated success in closing high-value, multi-year expansion deals
* Strong proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and standard business tools
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with experience engaging executive audiences
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate client needs into scalable solutions and business outcomes
* Highly organized with strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline
* Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving organization
* Ability to independently manage complex challenges while exercising sound judgment on escalation

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience selling into post-acute healthcare, broader healthcare, or health tech organizations
* Familiarity with value-based selling methodologies and enterprise account planning frameworks
* Experience collaborating with Customer Success or Client Engagement teams on retention and growth strategies

  

**Physical Demands of Our Work Environment**

* This position uses a computer and other office equipment as needed to perform duties. The in-office noise level in the work environment is typical of that of an office. Frequent interruptions may be encountered throughout the workday.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status, If you are unable to submit an application because of a incompatible assistive technology or disability, please contact us at careers@mosai.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Health and Wellness
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

As an Account Manager for our Health and Wellness vertical, you are responsible for driving expansion growth within our customer base. Your primary responsibility will be to foster strong relationships with existing clients, identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, and ensure their continued satisfaction and loyalty to our software solutions and services.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within the existing customer base through phone, video, email and face to face to understand their business goals and challenges.

* Create and execute strategic account plans to identify growth opportunities and drive expansion within assigned accounts.

* Deeply understand customers business needs and match to qualifying products and solutions.

* Identify and pursue opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional products and services that align with customer needs and objectives.

* Serve as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for their needs and ensuring they receive the highest level of service.

* Proactively manage contract renewals, ensuring high renewal rates and preventing churn.

* Collaborate with the Customer Success team to ensure customers are successfully adopting and leveraging our solutions to achieve their desired outcomes.

* Address and resolve customer issues and concerns in a timely and effective manner, coordinating with internal teams as needed.

* Maintain an accurate record of sales activities, leads, and opportunities in the CRM system. Develop and manage a sales pipeline of opportunities to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets. Leverage sales dashboards to understand where to focus your time and activities.

Provide regular updates and reports on account status, growth opportunities, and customer satisfaction metrics to management.  

  

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.

* Ability to think strategically and identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.

* Strong understanding of sales processes and techniques for upselling and cross-selling.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and persuasively.

* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to address and resolve customer issues effectively.

* Deep commitment to customer satisfaction and success, with a proactive and customer-centric approach.

* Ability to analyze customer data, market trends, and account metrics to inform strategy and decision-making.

* Exceptional organizational and time management skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.

* In-depth understanding of the software technology industry and market dynamics.

* Outstanding knowledge of MS Office and proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and customer success tools.

* Fast and adaptative learner, focused on improving customer and business processes.

* Advanced negotiation skills.

* Driven by achieving and exceeding targets, with a strong focus on results.

**Experience and Education Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field preferred.

3+ years of experience in software sales, preferably within the SMB and mid-market segments.  

  

Fullsteam supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. Fullsteam is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Dash.fi**

Dash.fi is a fast-growing fintech company offering corporate cards and adjacent financial products to SMB and enterprise businesses. We are building toward an acquisition exit and are in an aggressive growth phase — expanding verticals, scaling revenue operations, and building the infrastructure a durable business requires.

Dash.fi is building its Account Management function to create a proactive, commercially focused motion across the existing customer base. The Enterprise Account Manager will play a critical role in establishing that motion with Dash.fi's highest-value and most strategically important customers.

**The Role**

The Enterprise Account Manager owns a portfolio of Dash.fi's enterprise customers and is responsible for protecting and growing those relationships.

This is a strategic, commercially minded account management role—not a traditional customer success role. You will operate as the primary commercial owner for your accounts, developing executive relationships, understanding the customer's business and spend profile, identifying risk and expansion opportunities, and creating account strategies that drive retention and growth.

You will manage a smaller, high-value book of approximately 40–60 enterprise accounts, allowing for deeper customer engagement, executive relationships, QBRs, and complex commercial opportunities. You will work closely with the Head of AM, Sales, CS, Product, RevOps, and Commercial leadership to ensure customers have clear ownership and that opportunities and risks are acted on proactively.

**What You'll Do**

**Build the enterprise book**

* Own a portfolio of approximately 40–60 enterprise customers as their primary commercial point of contact, building executive relationships and account plans grounded in each customer's business, spend, and strategic objectives.

* Establish proactive engagement cadences so every strategic account has a clear next action.

**Protect customer retention**

* Monitor spend, engagement, and other health signals to catch early risk, then proactively address declining spend, friction, and other retention threats.

* Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders as needed and escalate material risks to the Head of AM with a clear action plan.

**Drive expansion & growth**

* Use customer conversations and account data to uncover expansion, cross-sell, and growth opportunities, executing the AM “Grow” program and managing opportunities in HubSpot.

* Partner with Product and Commercial leadership on new products, pricing, or deal structures, and build the business case to lead customers through the conversation.

**Lead the enterprise customer experience**

* Run strategic QBRs and business reviews that surface outcomes, opportunities, and risks—not just status updates.

* Gather and route customer feedback to Product, and ensure commitments are documented and followed through.

**Manage commercial interventions**

* Identify accounts needing strategic intervention on retention, pricing, or contract terms, and partner with the Head of AM and Commercial leadership on renegotiations.

* Translate commercial strategy into a clear account plan and keep complex deal cycles moving.

**Operate with discipline**

* Keep all customer activity, opportunities, and pipeline accurate in HubSpot, and use data—not just relationship strength—to prioritize engagement.

* Flag gaps in data, process, or tooling to the Head of AM.

**Partner cross-functionally**

* Work closely with Sales, CS, RevOps, Product, and Commercial leadership to keep ownership, data, and opportunities aligned.

* Clearly communicate dependencies and escalate blockers with a recommended path forward.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-haves**

* 5-7 years of experience in account management, strategic customer success, sales, or a related commercial customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, or a similar environment.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex B2B customer relationships and a strategic or enterprise book of business, with a track record of retaining and growing existing customers.

* Strong commercial instincts and comfort discussing spend, pricing, contracts, expansion, and business value.

* Experience identifying and managing customer risk proactively, with strong executive communication and relationship-building skills.

* Ability to build account strategies based on data, customer context, and business objectives, and to manage opportunities and customer activity in a CRM.

* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple strategic accounts simultaneously, comfortable operating where processes and playbooks are still being developed.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, CS, RevOps, and other teams.

**Strong advantages**

* Background in fintech, payments, corporate cards, expense management, or spend management, including selling or managing financial products.

* Experience with enterprise procurement, finance, AP, or expense stakeholders.

* Experience leading QBRs or executive business reviews and managing complex commercial negotiations.

* Experience working with multi-entity or multi-location organizations.

* HubSpot experience, and experience in a high-growth company where the operating model is still being defined.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Net Spend Retention across assigned accounts

* Logo retention

* Expansion pipeline

* Incremental customer spend

* Product penetration / cross-sell

* Growth in strategic accounts

* At-risk account identification and progression

* Pipeline accuracy and CRM hygiene

* QBR completion and resulting customer actions

* Customer engagement and relationship coverage

**Compensation & Structure**

This role carries a competitive OTE reflective of its scope.

**The structure is expected to align with the broader AM organization:**

* 70/30 base-to-variable split

* Variable compensation tied to retention and grow

jobs.description:
**About Dash.fi**

Dash.fi is a fast-growing fintech company offering corporate cards and adjacent financial products to SMB and enterprise businesses. We are building toward an acquisition exit and are in an aggressive growth phase — expanding verticals, scaling revenue operations, and building the infrastructure a durable business requires.

Dash.fi is building its Account Management function to create a proactive, commercially focused motion across the existing customer base. The SMB Account Manager will help create a scalable, data-driven approach to managing and growing Dash.fi's customer base.

**The Role**

The SMB Account Manager owns a high-volume portfolio of Dash.fi's small and mid-sized business customers and is responsible for retaining, engaging, and growing those customers through a scalable, proactive account management motion.

This is a high-velocity, data-driven commercial role. You will manage a portfolio of approximately 150–200 accounts, using established playbooks, digital-first engagement, and spend-triggered outreach to efficiently protect and grow the customer base.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, commercially curious, comfortable working with data, and energized by managing a large book of customers while continuously improving how that book is managed.

**What You'll Do**

**Own a high-volume SMB book**

* Own approximately 150–200 SMB accounts, prioritizing engagement based on spend, health, and opportunity while keeping HubSpot data accurate.
* Balance deeper relationships with priority accounts against efficient, scalable coverage across the broader book.

**Proactively manage retention risk**

* Monitor spend and health signals to catch churn risk early, engaging proactively and documenting retention actions.
* Loop in CS, Product, Support, and Sales as needed, and escalate recurring risks to the Head of AM.

**Drive customer growth**

* Use spend signals and account data to identify expansion and cross-sell opportunities, executing the “Grow” program and managing them in HubSpot.
* Follow established growth plays while flagging where they should evolve, partnering with the Head of AM on larger deals.

**Execute scalable customer outreach**

* Drive proactive, signal-based outreach—not just scheduled meetings—using data to time check-ins and messaging.
* Test and refine outreach strategies, helping identify which signals best predict engagement and retention.

**Manage the customer experience**

* Serve as a trusted point of contact, understanding each customer's priorities, usage, and the reasons behind spend changes.
* Coordinate internally for clear ownership and surface recurring feedback to the Head of AM and Product.

**Operate the AM playbook**

* Follow established SMB playbooks and cadences, keeping CRM data accurate and consistent.
* Flag where playbooks fall short and recommend improvements based on results.

**Partner cross-functionally**

* Work closely with Sales, CS, RevOps, and Product to keep ownership, data, and opportunities aligned.
* Escalate blockers to the Head of AM with a recommended path forward.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-haves**

* 2+ years of experience in account management, customer success, inside sales, sales, or another customer-facing commercial role.
* Experience managing multiple customers simultaneously in a high-volume environment, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Comfortable working with customer data and identifying trends or signals, with a commercial mindset and interest in retention, expansion, and customer growth.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to conduct proactive customer outreach across email, phone, and digital channels.
* Comfortable using CRM systems and maintaining accurate customer information.
* Ability to follow a playbook while recognizing opportunities to improve it, with strong follow-through and accountability.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, evolving environment, and customer-oriented without losing sight of commercial outcomes.

**Strong advantages**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, corporate cards, expense management, or spend management.
* Experience managing a book of 100+ customers, and with signal-based or lifecycle-based customer engagement.
* Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.
* Experience in a sales or account management environment with retention or expansion goals, using customer data to prioritize outreach.
* Experience working in a high-growth company where processes are still being developed.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Net Spend Retention across assigned accounts
* Logo retention
* Expansion pipeline
* Incremental customer spend
* Product penetration / cross-sell
* At-risk accounts proactively identified and mitigated
* Customer engagement / outreach effectiveness
* Pipeline accuracy and CRM hygiene
* Account coverage and next-action completion
* Adoption and effectiveness of SMB AM playbooks

**Compensation & Structure**

This role carries a competitive OTE reflective of its scope.

**The structure is expected to align with the broader AM organization:**

* 70/30 base-to-variable split
* Variable compensation tied to retention and growth outcomes
* Individual quota and attainment expectations aligned with the Head of AM's AM compensation framework
* Unlimited PTO
* 401k
* Insurance
* Equity participation may be available

Specific OTE bands and equity terms available on request. Dash.fi is committed to transparent, fair compensation.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description:
Salted is the largest delivery-first restaurant group in the United States, and we're hiring a Customer Experience Manager to be the standard-bearer for culinary excellence and customer experience across our kitchens.  
This is a hybrid role: part trainer, part auditor, part culture-carrier. You'll be the knowledge-bearer and teacher of culinary spec at Salted by setting brand expectations, recipes, and cooking methods, training new kitchen teams and launching new brands, auditing for consistency, and closing the loop between what customers experience and what kitchens execute. You'll thrive here if you excel in fast-moving, occasionally unstructured environments and have a track record of developing a culture of culinary excellence.  
  
**What You'll Do**  
**Training & Launches**

* Successfully train and launch high-impact brands in kitchens through culinary demos, mock service, and hands-on instruction
* Train new kitchen teams for new location launches, including spec, process, and organization
* Train the trainers at the District Manager and Kitchen Manager levels so standards cascade through every level of the business
* Build and maintain training materials, playbooks, and prep/par guides for every brand
* Provide training for new teams being onboarded as needed

**Spec, Quality & Consistency**

* Identify gaps in spec, retrain, and set clear expectations around culinary standards wherever they're needed
* Audit kitchens for food quality, consistency, and compliance with brand specs
* Review regular line checks and provide immediate, actionable feedback to field management
* Conduct remote line checks, secret shops, and camera reviews

**Customer Experience & Communication**

* Communicate rollouts and updates on menus, recipes, equipment, ingredients, and other key changes
* Close the feedback loop by resolving kitchen feedback tied to menus, recipes, equipment, and ingredients
* Cover kitchen operations in emergency scenarios to keep service running without interruption

**What You Bring**

* Extremely organized and detail-oriented, with strong analytical thinking
* Excellent written and verbal communication and comfortable giving direct, concise feedback to trainees and management
* High ownership and follow-through; self-motivated with a track record of getting things done
* Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and minimal structure
* A natural teacher and mentor, energized by developing people at every level
* A customer-focused mindset and excellent problem-solving ability

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of professional culinary, kitchen management, or kitchen training experience in a restaurant or quick service environment
* Experience training across multiple food concepts, cuisines, or brands
* Current food safety certification (e.g., ServSafe), or willingness to obtain one

**About Us:**

Matrix Medical Network is the nation’s leading independent provider of comprehensive in-home health assessments, serving Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid and Commercial patients across all 50 states. With a network of 3,000 + clinicians, we deliver personalized Whole Person Care that includes diagnostic testing, risk identification, medication management and preventive health education, empowering people to better manage acute and chronic conditions. Guided by our mantra- *We see you. We hear you. We’ve got you.*- and our core values of Integrity, Accountability, Trust, Respect and Passion, we are committed to creating a culture where both patients and teammates feel valued, supported and heard.

**Why Work at Matrix?**

  

* The opportunity to work with one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare whose vision is to provide unparalleled quality and value to providers and members.
* A chance to work with great people on exciting projects.
* Our opportunities allow you to leverage your expertise and compassion, making a direct impact to the health and well-being of members.
* Competitive Compensation: Be rewarded for your effort and passion while making a difference in the community.

**About the role:**

**Type:** Full Time, Salary

**Compensation:** $92,000-$138,000

**Location:** Fully Remote, must be in the United States

**Hours:** Full Time Days

They are also the business owner of workforce management and outbound campaign strategy in Genesys Cloud.

The role starts with the contact center: learning how BPO capacity on Matrix's Genesys platform, the dialer and vendor performance drive completed visits. As that foundation is in place, scope expands to the other channels that generate visits, including text, IVR and print. After a 60–90 day ramp, the role holds bounded authority to reallocate volume across vendors and campaigns within the locked plan.

**Key responsibilities**

**Demand-to-hours planning**

* Convert Enterprise Planning & Demand's forecast (required contacts and scheduled appointments by client, state and month) into production hours, using LCPH, contact rate, acceptance rate and dialable inventory.

* Maintain the rolling 90-day plan and issue the 30-day locked hours requirement to each vendor monthly, by week and day-part.
* Reconcile planned against actual hours weekly and report hours-requirement accuracy.
* Check driven appointment volume against NP slot capacity with Clinical Operations before raising hours.

**Vendor workforce governance**

* Measure staffed hours delivered by each vendor against the locked requirement, by week and interval, using Genesys data.
* Enforce the SOW's workforce terms: interval staffing floor, billable hours cap, efficiency floor, adherence target, flex notices and overtime pre-authorization.
* Reconcile invoiced payroll hours against Genesys login hours monthly, and document variances and credits owed.
* Own the workforce measures in the joint vendor scorecard, and prepare workforce content for weekly reviews, monthly performance reviews and QBRs.
* Track vendor attrition, ramp and hiring-wave delivery against plan.

**Genesys Cloud workforce management (business owner)**

* Design the business unit and management unit structure (one unit per vendor), with adherence rules and permissions for each.
* Define activity-code mapping so productive hours mean on-queue and campaign time, matching the SOW definition. Genesys defaults count meetings and training as work time.
* Ensure every vendor's schedules exist in Genesys, built there or imported, so adherence is measured on Matrix's platform.
* Own adherence, shrinkage and staffed-hours reporting from Genesys.
* Use Genesys forecasting and capacity planning for inbound work such as member callbacks.

**Outbound campaign strategy**

* Decide list segmentation and allocation by vendor and campaign. Each contact list runs on one campaign at a time, so list allocation is the main lever for splitting volume.
* Set dialing mode, calling windows by member time zone, abandon-rate thresholds and attempt cadence within Matrix's dialer rules, including the 20-attempt annual cap.
* Partner with telecom on caller ID and attestation to protect contact rate.
* Genesys administrators carry out configuration changes; this role decides them.

**Daily allocation and channel monitoring**

* Review prior-day performance by source: contact rate, acceptance rate, LCPH, scheduled and completed visits.
* Make same-day list and hours adjustments within the decision rights below.
* Watch disposition trends for signs that a model input has drifted.
* Track text, IVR and print response as inputs to voice hours, and as scope expands, recommend channel-mix shifts.

**Reporting and leadership support**

* Build and maintain the vendor scorecard and capacity dashboards in Power BI.
* Produce a monthly capacity outlook and channel performance summary with explicit recommendations.
* Contribute to ExCo materials, growing toward presenting portions of them.

* 5+ years in contact center workforce planning, capacity planning or operations analytics.

The Clinical Operations Lead supports the Clinical Trial Manager/operational team in execution of the trial (s). The position includes direct liaison with CROs and other ancillary vendors, as appropriate, to manage relevant trial(s) operational tasks. The Lead maintains effective communication with project team through oral and written correspondence, status reports to ensure alignment with study timelines.

The Healthcare Market Manager acts as the internal expert on market trends, dynamics, and customer needs for both the stationary and in-transit life science and medical service environmental monitoring businesses. This role is pivotal in defining where to play by translating market insights into actionable strategies, investment priorities, and long-term growth opportunities aligned with business objectives. They also lead market research, maintain the Copeland market model, and assess competitive, industry, and regulatory trends to inform cross-functional teams.

  

**AS A HEALTHCARE MARKET MANAGER, YOU WILL:**

* Collaborate to develop and deliver the Copeland Healthcare Business Strategy Plan, including market sizing, key trends analysis, and competitor insights

* Create market roadmaps to guide product and solution development

* Identify M&A opportunities in both stationary and in-transit environmental monitoring markets and develop strategic roadmaps

new_jobs.description:
**Femmes Against Violence Program**  
**Program Coordinator**

***Full-time, Union Position***

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Description:** Femmes Against Violence (FAV) is an 18-week, cohort-based program that promotes healing, agency, leadership, and self-determination among youth ages 14–21, including femme-identified and gender-expansive youth of color. Offered twice annually, FAV engages youth three days per week through culturally affirming, gender-responsive, youth-centered programming.

The program integrates intersectional, liberatory frameworks grounded in Black feminist theory, Indigenous teachings, ancestral knowledge, collective care, and community accountability through interactive workshops, experiential activities, community outings, guest speakers, and youth-led action projects. Programming explores identity, culture, relationships, gender-based violence prevention, systems of power and oppression, and pathways toward personal and collective well-being. Youth develop critical consciousness, leadership, advocacy, communication, and self-determination skills while engaging in opportunities to apply their learning through creative and experiential activities.

FAV also provides a wraparound support model that connects youth to mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources. FAV creates a supportive space where youth can build belonging, strengthen their voices and leadership capacity, develop healthy coping and relationship skills, and envision and pursue futures grounded in care, justice, and self-determination.

* Facilitate culturally and gender-affirming trainings, workshops, group activities, presentations, and community outings for FAV participants.
* Support youth in developing and implementing creative projects, presentations, educational materials, and other activities that promote awareness, leadership, advocacy, and positive community engagement.
* Work collaboratively with other Horizons programs to ensure a cohesive program model and coordinated services for participating youth.

* Network and participate in community committees, meetings, and collaborative efforts that promote FAV, strengthen partnerships, and expand resources and opportunities for participants.
* Coordinate with participants and staff to implement evaluation and feedback tools that measure program effectiveness, participant satisfaction, and progress toward program outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and timely program records, participant documentation, data, reports, and budgets, including required entries into the agency's CMS and GMS system.
* Facilitate connections to wraparound and support services, including mental health and wellness, case management, educational, housing, and other community resources.
* Participate in weekly team meetings, individual supervision, and other internal meetings that support effective program delivery and professional development.
* Complete required agency and funder trainings and maintain knowledge of applicable program standards, policies, and funding requirements.
* Participate in at least one agency-wide committee, project, or working group annually.
* Attend agency and funder meetings, quarterly All Grantee meetings, and other meetings that support programmatic integration within the agency and broader community.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by the Program Director.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree in psychology, women’s or ethnic studies and/or a closely related field, and/or comparable experience to meet this requirement (2+ years).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience working with self-identified young women of color who have been system-impacted.
* Direct knowledge regarding youth development and empowerment principles, intervention strategies, best practices in serving system-impacted youth, harm reduction, etc.
* Experience coordinating after-school, leadership or other youth programming.
* Extensive knowledge of gender-based violence intervention strategies, sexual assault, domestic violence a must.

new_jobs.title: Receivership Project Coordinator

Griswold Receivers is seeking a full-time California Receivership Project Coordinator to support the management and oversight of 40–45 active receivership projects. This is a hybrid role that will include traveling to properties across Northern California and Nevada as needed.

In the field, you’ll conduct site inspections, coordinate with city inspectors and contractors to plan and schedule work, manage property needs such as utility setup, fencing, and security, help relocate occupants and tenants, and track overall project progress. The Project Coordinator will report to the Director, Northern California Property Management and work closely with the Operations Team to carry out day-to-day tasks for each project.

The Receivership Project Coordinator will help coordinate receivership projects from start to finish, keeping them on time, on budget, and done well. We’re looking for a proactive team player who likes working with others and takes initiative to keep projects moving. Partnering closely with the Director of Northern California Property Management, this role monitors properties, resolves issues quickly, and plays a key part in carrying out court-appointed receivership responsibilities.

 **Compensation:**

$75,000 - $85,000 yearly

 **Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple receivership projects from start to finish.
* Travel to properties throughout Northern California and Nevada to conduct inspections, monitor progress, and address issues.
* Work with city inspectors, contractors, and vendors to schedule and plan required work.
* Assist with the setup and management of property services, including utilities, fencing, and security.
* Support the relocation of occupants and tenants as needed, including identifying options and coordinating logistics.
* Monitor project timelines to keep projects on track.
* Maintain accurate records of property conditions and work performed, including photos and inspection notes.
* Prepare regular status updates and reports for the Director and Operations Team.
* Respond to urgent property issues such as damage, vandalism, or security concerns.
* Act as a point of contact for tenants and neighbors, handling concerns professionally and maintaining positive relationships.
* Work with internal teams and outside stakeholders to keep projects running efficiently.

 **Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years of property management and/or construction management experience.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-compliance environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic project management tools.

 **About Company**

Griswold Receivers and its professionals serve exclusively as Court-appointed neutrals in a variety of legal scenarios, including health & safety receiverships, tenant habitability receiverships, post-judgment receiverships, business dispute receiverships, rents/profits receiverships, and partition actions. These matters often lead to a variety of types of rehabilitation and construction projects.

We embrace a team-centric environment and approach to support one another in our respective roles, while also remaining flexible and adaptable to take on different roles as the project may require. Our team possesses a high level of integrity and keeps a level head during high-pressure or potentially volatile situations without losing sight of the end goal.

**COMPENSATION & COMPANY BENEFITS INCLUDE:**

Salary is dependent on experience & skillset. Benefits include an incentive plan, 401(k) (after waiting period), paid holidays, wellness reimbursement program, and paid time off.

Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About This Role:**

* As a Sustainability Program Manager, you will be an important member of Crusoe's sustainability team, transforming sustainability commitments into day-to-day operational reality. You will own the processes, training, and tracking that make our sustainability KPIs achievable and enforceable across a rapidly expanding portfolio of AI data centers and energy assets. You’ll work directly with cross-functional teams to translate targets into requirements, workflows, and accountability at the site and project level. This role suits someone with technical fluency in how manufacturing facilities and data centers are built and run, who is energized by designing scalable processes, driving adoption, and closing the gap between commitment and performance.

**What You’ll Be Working On:**

* Lead operational sustainability initiatives related to water, waste, and carbon, from scoping through delivery, building project plans, aligning stakeholders, tracking milestones, and surfacing risks early.
* Support sustainability implementation throughout the lifecycle of data center projects by helping to define, monitor, and improve data center construction and operational efficiency metrics, including embodied carbon, waste diversion, PUE, and WUE. Partner with internal teams and external partners to identify performance gaps and drive improvements.
* Design and implement the processes, SOPs, and checklists that embed sustainability requirements into manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and site operations, and train site teams, contractors, and partners to apply them consistently.
* Support green building certification strategies (e.g., LEED, Green Globes) across new builds, coordinating documentation, consultants, and design team inputs.
* Build and maintain dashboards, trackers, and automated workflows that give teams timely visibility into operational performance, using AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort.
* Manage renewable energy tracking and energy performance data, working with Energy, Finance, and Operations teams to monitor portfolio status and surface risks and opportunities.
* Provide as-needed support across the broader sustainability team, flexing into emerging priorities, ad-hoc data requests, and new initiatives as the business evolves.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, environmental science, sustainability, data analytics, or a related field. Candidates from other backgrounds with demonstrated technical depth are encouraged to apply.
* **Experience:** 4-7 years of professional experience in sustainability operations, construction or energy management, supply chain or supplier management, or environmental consulting, ideally within the data center, cloud infrastructure, energy, or technology sectors. This should include hands-on management of operational programs, performance metrics, or compliance and enforcement processes.
* **Data Center & Energy Knowledge:** Strong understanding of data center construction and operations, including metrics (PUE, WUE, CUE) and power, cooling, and energy systems. Familiarity with renewable energy instruments and energy markets.
* **Program Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, and influence stakeholders.
* **Process Design:** Proven ability to design, document, and roll out scalable processes, SOPs, and controls across many stakeholders and sites, and to drive adoption and adherence.
* **Supply Chain & Vendor Engagement**: Experience engaging suppliers, contractors, or vendors to set requirements, build capability, and hold them accountable to performance expectations, including through contract terms, scorecards, and corrective action.
* **Technical & Analytical Skills:** Advanced proficiency in Excel and strong data skills, such as SQL, Python, or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker). Experience building trackers, dashboards, and data quality controls.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex sustainability data into clear narratives for diverse stakeholders.
* **Adaptability & Ownership**: Self-starter who exercises sound judgment under ambiguity, proactively surfaces risks and opportunities, and takes full ownership of outcomes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity with green building certifications (LEED AP, Green Globes) or embodied carbon in construction, including whole building LCA tools (e.g., EC3, One Click LCA, Tally).
* Experience running supplier engagement or responsible sourcing programs, such as supplier scorecards, audits, or sustainability requirements in procurement.
* Comfort using AI tool

Many of the practices that carried us this far, such as workflows patched together with one-off configurations, tooling choices made vendor by vendor, and process knowledge that lives with a few individuals, will not hold as hiring volume rises and we open in new countries.

We are hiring a senior owner to build what comes next.

You will be responsible for the product side of Talent Acquisition: advising on the road map for our recruiting tech stack (Ashby, sourcing tools, Metaview), the design of hiring workflows from requisition intake to onboarding handoff, and the programs that make our processes work globally. Right now, improvements tend to happen when someone feels enough pain to raise them. In this role, you make improvement a steady, planned part of how TA works.

The right person is a program manager who designs durable systems rather than one-time fixes, is comfortable with workflow automation and AI-enabled tools, and can keep recruiters, hiring managers, and vendors on track without having them report to you.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* *Recruiting technology and vendor strategy*

  + Advise TA leadership on the roadmap for the recruiting tech stack. Identify where automation, AI, integrations, and self-service can reduce manual work across Ashby, our sourcing tools, and Metaview.
  + Partner with vendors and internal partners on how AI and agentic tools can make recruiters more effective, and confirm that each technology choice is sustainable to maintain.
  + Create a lightweight framework for evaluating and approving new tools, since none exists today.
* *Workflow analysis and process redesign*

  + Map the full candidate and hiring lifecycle, from requisition intake through offer and onboarding handoff, and surface friction and duplicated effort proactively.
  + Redesign processes with methods such as Lean, Six Sigma, and the 5 Whys, weighing system configuration, user experience, and policy changes against the outcome you want.
  + Maintain current process documentation and workflow maps so that Recruiting, People Technology, and Legal can self-serve instead of submitting requests.
* *Business cases, metrics, and prioritization*

  + Write business cases that put numbers on operational impact, experience gains, and ROI, then use them to rank initiatives by impact, scalability, and strategic fit.
  + Work with Recruiting leadership and Analytics to define and report on core recruiting metrics, and investigate the underlying cause when a target is missed.
  + Support preparation of the regular metrics reviews and executive summaries TA leadership shares with the business.
  + Track adoption and realized ROI against each business case after launch.
* *Global expansion enablement*

  + Build recruiting processes and tooling that scale and meet local requirements as we enter new regions, working closely with Legal, Compliance, and regional partners.
  + Build local hiring regulations, data privacy, and AI compliance into designs from the start rather than adding them later.
  + Develop a reusable launch playbook for hiring at each new site.
* *Program and portfolio management*

  + Lead transformation and technology initiatives from start to finish: scoping, requirements, project plans, user acceptance testing, launch readiness, and post-launch review.
  + Run pilots and phased rollouts with success criteria agreed in advance, and use the results to expand, refine, or retire the initiative.
  + Balance the full portfolio of work against competing priorities, capacity, and timelines.
* *Change management and adoption*

  + Manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholders across Recruiting, People Technology, Legal, Compliance, and the business, and clear blockers early.
  + Plan the communications, training, and feedback loops for every rollout. A launch only counts once people are using the new way of working.
* *Systems and automation*

  + Treat repeated manual follow-up as a signal that something needs to be automated, and replace it with a form, workflow, dashboard, or scheduled alert.
  + Keep the configuration, documentation, and structure of the tools and files these programs depend on in good order, and move work into proper systems wherever they exist.
  + Produce a playbook that any recruiter, coordinator, or program manager can follow without your involvement.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8+ years in recruiting operations, including TA program management, or product management, with experience in a fast-growing company and a history of taking on broader scope and influence.
* A record of leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs from business case through launch, including UAT, communications

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Data Transformation
new_jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

As Program Manager, Data Transformation, you will run the day-to-day program engine that turns Oura's business data into governed, trusted, decision-ready metrics. You will work inside the Data Transformation program, alongside the Staff Program Manager, and own the delivery rhythm for your assigned data domains: intake, prioritization, tracking, ownership, certification, and reporting. Early focus areas include Hardware and Supply Chain, where the need for structure is greatest.A core part of the job is metric certification and intake discipline. You will enforce the three-path model for every request and metric: Directional (fit for use, fast), Governed (executive, board, investor, or external numbers, with a certification path), and Not ours (operational or application work rerouted to the owning business team). You will also drive the work itself, including sprints where they help, so certification and delivery commitments actually land.Hardware and supply chain data, for example, spans manufacturing, quality, logistics, sourcing, planning, and new product introduction. This role connects those teams to Data Engineering and Analytics so that the numbers executives, finance, and auditors rely on (for example warranty rate, click-to-delivery, and yield) have one definition, one owner, and a clear path from directional to governed to certified.This role is ideal for a program manager who is comfortable in ambiguity, can read a data pipeline diagram as easily as a project plan, and likes bringing structure to fast-moving, cross-functional work.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Take business metrics from informally tracked to fully certified, each with a locked definition, a single accountable owner, and documented lineage and controls
* Make sure every key metric in your domains has a clear owner and approver, and keep that ownership current as the business changes
* Triage incoming data requests by their intended use and level of rigor, and route work that belongs to other teams to the right place
* Run a structured intake process with clear priorities, business justification, and reliable response times
* Drive cross-functional programs to completion across Data Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Hardware, and IT, using agile practices where they help
* Keep program plans accurate and visible, with named leads, dates, and status that stakeholders can trust
* Track data issues and metric regressions through to resolution, and support documentation for internal and external audit
* Communicate progress and data health clearly to senior leaders, and drive adoption of standardized metric definitions

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

### **What you'll bring**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in program management, technical program management, or business operations, including time supporting data, analytics, or operations teams
* Experience running cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and competing priorities, without formal authority
* Experience with metric governance or controls work: definitions, ownership, documentation, and formal sign-off
* Comfortable working in Databricks or a similar lakehouse: can navigate the catalog, read a SQL query or model to understand how a metric is computed, and spot-check numbers against source tables
* Working understanding of data pipelines and transformation layers (dbt or equivalent): can follow lineage from source system to reported number and explain where a metric is computed
* Experience with data quality controls: defining validation tests, reading test results, and tracing failures to root cause
* Comfort holding a process line with senior stakeholders, including redirecting requests, while keeping relationships intact
* Hands-on experience with work tracking tools such as Jira, and with running sprints or lightweight agile cadences
* Clear written and verbal communication, including status reporting for senior audiences
  

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience with hardware, manufacturing, quality, logistics, sourcing, or supply planning
* Background in consumer hardware, wearables, medical devices, or another regulated hardware business
* Exposure to financial reporting, SOX-style controls, audit preparation, or IPO readiness
* Experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO company
* Experience working with distributed teams across US and European time zones
* Comfort using modern AI tooling to speed up analysis, documentation, and reporting

### **Benefits**

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive salary
* Lunch benefit
* Wellness benefit
* Flexible working hours
* Collaborative, smart teammates
* An Ōura ring of your own
* Wellness Time Off
  

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. **About Veeco**  
You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

  

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers.

  

**OVERVIEW**
============

  

Veeco is transferring existing Advanced Packaging Lithography and Laser Annealing products to contract manufacturing partners in Asia for reliable volume production. This position will report to Vice President, Supply Chain in a full-time role requiring significant international engagement during the first 6–12 months to support new contract manufacturing partnerships in Asia. 25%–50% global travel

As Senior Program Manager, Contract Manufacturing Operations, you will lead this high-complexity transfer from integrated planning through manufacturing readiness, aligning suppliers and Veeco teams on schedule, quality, cost, and production objectives. Your work will strengthen the scale and execution behind technologies Veeco uses in advanced semiconductor fabrication and packaging. During this 6–12 month rotational assignment, you will establish the operating rhythm, controls, and supplier capability required for a successful ramp; after the assignment, you are expected to move into a broader Operations role supporting Manufacturing or Supply Chain, based on business needs.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
====================

* Own the end-to-end transfer of existing Advanced Packaging Lithography and Laser Annealing products to contract manufacturers in Asia, delivering production readiness against agreed schedule, quality, cost, and capacity objectives.
* Build and maintain the integrated program plan, critical path, decision log, risk register, and mitigation actions that keep supplier and Veeco workstreams aligned.
* Lead cross-functional execution across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and supplier teams, resolving system-level issues and clarifying ownership.

* Provide executive-level reporting on schedule, technical status, cost, resource needs, and risks, with clear decisions and recovery actions.
* Deliver operational-excellence and cost-reduction initiatives that improve manufacturability, throughput, quality, and total cost while protecting product performance.
* Establish durable governance, metrics, and escalation paths that enable contract manufacturing partners to sustain volume production after transfer completion.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 8 years of related experience leading engineering, manufacturing, or product-transfer programs for semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, or similarly complex capital equipment.
* Experience leading multiple concurrent programs that involve cross-functional teams, external suppliers, and executive stakeholders.
* Experience managing new product introduction or product-transfer work through manufacturing readiness and production ramp.
* Ability to travel globally 25%–50% during the 6–12 month rotational assignment.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**
====================================

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Power BI, Smartsheet, enterprise resource planning and material requirements planning systems, and product lifecycle management tools; experience with SAP is preferred.
